==== cell e1_arith_widths ====
cell 0 entry=run params=2 ret_regs=1 wide_ret=false state_len=0
consts 
// generated by rustmsl — do not edit; semantics are the cell80-core interpreter's
#include <metal_stdlib>
using namespace metal;

struct Ctx {
    ushort slots[4];
    uchar state[1];
    device const uchar* cst;
    uint cst_len;
    uint slot_bytes;
    uint state_len;
    uint trap;
    uint halt;
    uint fuel;
    uint r0; uint r1; uint r2;
    uint rw;
    uint rn;
};

// The interpreter's tick(): one unit per statement, per expression
// node, per loop iteration; exhaustion is a trap, never a hang.
#define TICK if (--c.fuel == 0u) { c.trap = 4u; return; }
// Cell functions are pinned noinline: the shipped configuration is
// exactly the battery-validated one, not an inliner heuristic's.
#define CELLFN __attribute__((noinline))

// Sign-extend a masked 16-bit lane / bit-cast a 32-bit lane to signed.
static int sx16(uint x) { return (int)as_type<short>((ushort)(x)); }
static int sx32(uint x) { return as_type<int>(x); }

// Division rides opaque value-taking helpers: Metal's backend
// miscompiles a divide feeding a branch that guards stores through
// a thread-reference param (branch polarity inverts — caught by the
// E3 megakernel battery on `mul_sat`, minimised to a 10-line repro).
// The call boundary blocks the faulty fusion; zero-checks stay at
// the call site (the trap), and the signed MIN/-1 wrap lives here.
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint udiv(uint a, uint b) { return a / b; }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint urem(uint a, uint b) { return a % b; }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint sdiv16(uint a, uint b) { return ((uint)(sx16(a) / sx16(b))) & 0xFFFFu; }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint srem16(uint a, uint b) { return ((uint)(sx16(a) % sx16(b))) & 0xFFFFu; }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint sdiv32(uint a, uint b) { return (a == 0x80000000u && b == 0xFFFFFFFFu) ? a : (uint)(sx32(a) / sx32(b)); }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint srem32(uint a, uint b) { return (a == 0x80000000u && b == 0xFFFFFFFFu) ? 0u : (uint)(sx32(a) % sx32(b)); }

// Byte-routed window emulation: consts (read-only), the slot file,
// the state struct, else zero on read and a trap on write (the
// pre-registered E1 weakening).
static uint rd8(thread Ctx& c, uint a) {
    a &= 0xFFFFu;
    if (a >= 0x8000u && a < 0x8000u + c.cst_len) return (uint)c.cst[a - 0x8000u];
    if (a >= 0x9000u && a < 0x9000u + c.slot_bytes) {
        uint o = a - 0x9000u;
        return ((uint)c.slots[o >> 1] >> ((o & 1u) * 8u)) & 0xFFu;
    }
    if (a >= 0xB000u && a < 0xB000u + c.state_len) return (uint)c.state[a - 0xB000u];
    return 0u;
}
static void wr8(thread Ctx& c, uint a, uint v) {
    a &= 0xFFFFu;
    if (a >= 0x9000u && a < 0x9000u + c.slot_bytes) {
        uint o = a - 0x9000u;
        uint i = o >> 1;
        uint sh = (o & 1u) * 8u;
        c.slots[i] = (ushort)(((uint)c.slots[i] & ~(0xFFu << sh)) | ((v & 0xFFu) << sh));
        return;
    }
    if (a >= 0xB000u && a < 0xB000u + c.state_len) {
        c.state[a - 0xB000u] = (uchar)(v & 0xFFu);
        return;
    }
    c.trap = 3u;
}
static uint rd16(thread Ctx& c, uint a) { return rd8(c, a) | (rd8(c, a + 1u) << 8u); }
static void wr16(thread Ctx& c, uint a, uint v) { wr8(c, a, v); wr8(c, a + 1u, v >> 8u); }
static uint rd32(thread Ctx& c, uint a) { return rd16(c, a) | (rd16(c, a + 2u) << 16u); }
static void wr32(thread Ctx& c, uint a, uint v) { wr16(c, a, v); wr16(c, a + 2u, v >> 16u); }

static CELLFN void c0_f_run(thread Ctx& c);
static CELLFN void c0_f_run(thread Ctx& c) {
    c.r0 = 0u; c.r1 = 0u; c.r2 = 0u; c.rw = 0u; c.rn = 0u;
    TICK
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t1 = (uint)c.slots[0u];
    uint t2 = t1 & 0xFFu;
    c.slots[2u] = (ushort)(t2);
    TICK
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t3 = (uint)c.slots[1u];
    uint t4 = t3 & 0xFFu;
    c.slots[3u] = (ushort)(t4);
    TICK
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t5 = (uint)c.slots[2u];
    TICK
    uint t6 = (uint)c.slots[3u];
    uint t7 = (t5 + t6) & 0xFFu;
    TICK
    TICK
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t8 = (uint)c.slots[2u];
    TICK
    uint t9 = (uint)c.slots[3u];
    uint t10 = (t8 * t9) & 0xFFu;
    uint t11 = (t10 << 8u) & 0xFFFFu;
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t12 = (uint)c.slots[0u];
    TICK
    uint t13 = (uint)c.slots[1u];
    uint t14 = (t12 & t13) & 0xFFFFu;
    uint t15 = (t11 ^ t14) & 0xFFFFu;
    uint t16 = (t7 | t15) & 0xFFFFu;
    c.r0 = t16;
    c.rn = 1u;
}

kernel void cell_main(
    device const ushort* inp [[buffer(0)]],
    device ushort* outp [[buffer(1)]],
    device const uchar* cst [[buffer(2)]],
    constant uint& n_inputs [[buffer(3)]],
    device const uchar* stin [[buffer(4)]],
    device uchar* stout [[buffer(5)]],
    uint tid [[thread_position_in_grid]])
{
    uint cell = tid / n_inputs;
    uint idx = tid % n_inputs;
    Ctx c = {};
    c.fuel = 100000000u;
    uint r0 = 0u; uint r1 = 0u; uint r2 = 0u;
    switch (cell) {
    case 0u: {
        c.cst = cst + 0u;
        c.cst_len = 0u;
        c.slot_bytes = 8u;
        c.slots[0u] = inp[idx * 3u + 0u];
        c.slots[1u] = inp[idx * 3u + 1u];
        c0_f_run(c);
        r0 = (c.rn > 0u) ? c.r0 : 0u;
        r1 = (c.rn > 1u) ? c.r1 : 0u;
        r2 = (c.rn > 2u) ? c.r2 : 0u;
        break; }
    }
    uint steps = 100000000u - c.fuel;
    if (c.trap != 0u) {
        r0 = (c.trap == 2u) ? (c.halt & 0xFFFFu) : 0u;
        r1 = 0u;
        r2 = 0u;
    }
    outp[tid * 6u + 0u] = (ushort)r0;
    outp[tid * 6u + 1u] = (ushort)r1;
    outp[tid * 6u + 2u] = (ushort)r2;
    outp[tid * 6u + 3u] = (ushort)c.trap;
    outp[tid * 6u + 4u] = (ushort)(steps & 0xFFFFu);
    outp[tid * 6u + 5u] = (ushort)(steps >> 16u);
}

==== cell e1_div_signed16 ====
cell 0 entry=run params=2 ret_regs=1 wide_ret=false state_len=0
consts 
// generated by rustmsl — do not edit; semantics are the cell80-core interpreter's
#include <metal_stdlib>
using namespace metal;

struct Ctx {
    ushort slots[2];
    uchar state[1];
    device const uchar* cst;
    uint cst_len;
    uint slot_bytes;
    uint state_len;
    uint trap;
    uint halt;
    uint fuel;
    uint r0; uint r1; uint r2;
    uint rw;
    uint rn;
};

// The interpreter's tick(): one unit per statement, per expression
// node, per loop iteration; exhaustion is a trap, never a hang.
#define TICK if (--c.fuel == 0u) { c.trap = 4u; return; }
// Cell functions are pinned noinline: the shipped configuration is
// exactly the battery-validated one, not an inliner heuristic's.
#define CELLFN __attribute__((noinline))

// Sign-extend a masked 16-bit lane / bit-cast a 32-bit lane to signed.
static int sx16(uint x) { return (int)as_type<short>((ushort)(x)); }
static int sx32(uint x) { return as_type<int>(x); }

// Division rides opaque value-taking helpers: Metal's backend
// miscompiles a divide feeding a branch that guards stores through
// a thread-reference param (branch polarity inverts — caught by the
// E3 megakernel battery on `mul_sat`, minimised to a 10-line repro).
// The call boundary blocks the faulty fusion; zero-checks stay at
// the call site (the trap), and the signed MIN/-1 wrap lives here.
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint udiv(uint a, uint b) { return a / b; }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint urem(uint a, uint b) { return a % b; }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint sdiv16(uint a, uint b) { return ((uint)(sx16(a) / sx16(b))) & 0xFFFFu; }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint srem16(uint a, uint b) { return ((uint)(sx16(a) % sx16(b))) & 0xFFFFu; }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint sdiv32(uint a, uint b) { return (a == 0x80000000u && b == 0xFFFFFFFFu) ? a : (uint)(sx32(a) / sx32(b)); }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint srem32(uint a, uint b) { return (a == 0x80000000u && b == 0xFFFFFFFFu) ? 0u : (uint)(sx32(a) % sx32(b)); }

// Byte-routed window emulation: consts (read-only), the slot file,
// the state struct, else zero on read and a trap on write (the
// pre-registered E1 weakening).
static uint rd8(thread Ctx& c, uint a) {
    a &= 0xFFFFu;
    if (a >= 0x8000u && a < 0x8000u + c.cst_len) return (uint)c.cst[a - 0x8000u];
    if (a >= 0x9000u && a < 0x9000u + c.slot_bytes) {
        uint o = a - 0x9000u;
        return ((uint)c.slots[o >> 1] >> ((o & 1u) * 8u)) & 0xFFu;
    }
    if (a >= 0xB000u && a < 0xB000u + c.state_len) return (uint)c.state[a - 0xB000u];
    return 0u;
}
static void wr8(thread Ctx& c, uint a, uint v) {
    a &= 0xFFFFu;
    if (a >= 0x9000u && a < 0x9000u + c.slot_bytes) {
        uint o = a - 0x9000u;
        uint i = o >> 1;
        uint sh = (o & 1u) * 8u;
        c.slots[i] = (ushort)(((uint)c.slots[i] & ~(0xFFu << sh)) | ((v & 0xFFu) << sh));
        return;
    }
    if (a >= 0xB000u && a < 0xB000u + c.state_len) {
        c.state[a - 0xB000u] = (uchar)(v & 0xFFu);
        return;
    }
    c.trap = 3u;
}
static uint rd16(thread Ctx& c, uint a) { return rd8(c, a) | (rd8(c, a + 1u) << 8u); }
static void wr16(thread Ctx& c, uint a, uint v) { wr8(c, a, v); wr8(c, a + 1u, v >> 8u); }
static uint rd32(thread Ctx& c, uint a) { return rd16(c, a) | (rd16(c, a + 2u) << 16u); }
static void wr32(thread Ctx& c, uint a, uint v) { wr16(c, a, v); wr16(c, a + 2u, v >> 16u); }

static CELLFN void c0_f_run(thread Ctx& c);
static CELLFN void c0_f_run(thread Ctx& c) {
    c.r0 = 0u; c.r1 = 0u; c.r2 = 0u; c.rw = 0u; c.rn = 0u;
    TICK
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t1 = (uint)c.slots[0u];
    TICK
    uint t2 = (uint)c.slots[1u];
    if (t2 == 0u) { c.trap = 1u; return; }
    uint t3 = sdiv16(t1, t2);
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t4 = (uint)c.slots[0u];
    TICK
    uint t5 = (uint)c.slots[1u];
    if (t5 == 0u) { c.trap = 1u; return; }
    uint t6 = srem16(t4, t5);
    uint t7 = (t3 + t6) & 0xFFFFu;
    c.r0 = t7;
    c.rn = 1u;
}

kernel void cell_main(
    device const ushort* inp [[buffer(0)]],
    device ushort* outp [[buffer(1)]],
    device const uchar* cst [[buffer(2)]],
    constant uint& n_inputs [[buffer(3)]],
    device const uchar* stin [[buffer(4)]],
    device uchar* stout [[buffer(5)]],
    uint tid [[thread_position_in_grid]])
{
    uint cell = tid / n_inputs;
    uint idx = tid % n_inputs;
    Ctx c = {};
    c.fuel = 100000000u;
    uint r0 = 0u; uint r1 = 0u; uint r2 = 0u;

    case 0u: {
        c.cst = cst + 0u;
        c.cst_len = 0u;
        c.slot_bytes = 4u;
        c.slots[0u] = inp[idx * 3u + 0u];
        c.slots[1u] = inp[idx * 3u + 1u];
        c0_f_run(c);
        r0 = (c.rn > 0u) ? c.r0 : 0u;
        r1 = (c.rn > 1u) ? c.r1 : 0u;
        r2 = (c.rn > 2u) ? c.r2 : 0u;
        break; }
    }
    uint steps = 100000000u - c.fuel;
    if (c.trap != 0u) {
        r0 = (c.trap == 2u) ? (c.halt & 0xFFFFu) : 0u;
        r1 = 0u;
        r2 = 0u;
    }
    outp[tid * 6u + 0u] = (ushort)r0;
    outp[tid * 6u + 1u] = (ushort)r1;
    outp[tid * 6u + 2u] = (ushort)r2;
    outp[tid * 6u + 3u] = (ushort)c.trap;
    outp[tid * 6u + 4u] = (ushort)(steps & 0xFFFFu);
    outp[tid * 6u + 5u] = (ushort)(steps >> 16u);

==== cell e1_div_unsigned16 ====
cell 0 entry=run params=2 ret_regs=1 wide_ret=false state_len=0
consts 
// generated by rustmsl — do not edit; semantics are the cell80-core interpreter's
#include <metal_stdlib>
using namespace metal;

struct Ctx {
    ushort slots[2];
    uchar state[1];
    device const uchar* cst;
    uint cst_len;
    uint slot_bytes;
    uint state_len;
    uint trap;
    uint halt;
    uint fuel;
    uint r0; uint r1; uint r2;
    uint rw;
    uint rn;
};

// The interpreter's tick(): one unit per statement, per expression
// node, per loop iteration; exhaustion is a trap, never a hang.
#define TICK if (--c.fuel == 0u) { c.trap = 4u; return; }
// Cell functions are pinned noinline: the shipped configuration is
// exactly the battery-validated one, not an inliner heuristic's.
#define CELLFN __attribute__((noinline))

// Sign-extend a masked 16-bit lane / bit-cast a 32-bit lane to signed.
static int sx16(uint x) { return (int)as_type<short>((ushort)(x)); }
static int sx32(uint x) { return as_type<int>(x); }

// Division rides opaque value-taking helpers: Metal's backend
// miscompiles a divide feeding a branch that guards stores through
// a thread-reference param (branch polarity inverts — caught by the
// E3 megakernel battery on `mul_sat`, minimised to a 10-line repro).
// The call boundary blocks the faulty fusion; zero-checks stay at
// the call site (the trap), and the signed MIN/-1 wrap lives here.
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint udiv(uint a, uint b) { return a / b; }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint urem(uint a, uint b) { return a % b; }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint sdiv16(uint a, uint b) { return ((uint)(sx16(a) / sx16(b))) & 0xFFFFu; }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint srem16(uint a, uint b) { return ((uint)(sx16(a) % sx16(b))) & 0xFFFFu; }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint sdiv32(uint a, uint b) { return (a == 0x80000000u && b == 0xFFFFFFFFu) ? a : (uint)(sx32(a) / sx32(b)); }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint srem32(uint a, uint b) { return (a == 0x80000000u && b == 0xFFFFFFFFu) ? 0u : (uint)(sx32(a) % sx32(b)); }

// Byte-routed window emulation: consts (read-only), the slot file,
// the state struct, else zero on read and a trap on write (the
// pre-registered E1 weakening).
static uint rd8(thread Ctx& c, uint a) {
    a &= 0xFFFFu;
    if (a >= 0x8000u && a < 0x8000u + c.cst_len) return (uint)c.cst[a - 0x8000u];
    if (a >= 0x9000u && a < 0x9000u + c.slot_bytes) {
        uint o = a - 0x9000u;
        return ((uint)c.slots[o >> 1] >> ((o & 1u) * 8u)) & 0xFFu;
    }
    if (a >= 0xB000u && a < 0xB000u + c.state_len) return (uint)c.state[a - 0xB000u];
    return 0u;
}
static void wr8(thread Ctx& c, uint a, uint v) {
    a &= 0xFFFFu;
    if (a >= 0x9000u && a < 0x9000u + c.slot_bytes) {
        uint o = a - 0x9000u;
        uint i = o >> 1;
        uint sh = (o & 1u) * 8u;
        c.slots[i] = (ushort)(((uint)c.slots[i] & ~(0xFFu << sh)) | ((v & 0xFFu) << sh));
        return;
    }
    if (a >= 0xB000u && a < 0xB000u + c.state_len) {
        c.state[a - 0xB000u] = (uchar)(v & 0xFFu);
        return;
    }
    c.trap = 3u;
}
static uint rd16(thread Ctx& c, uint a) { return rd8(c, a) | (rd8(c, a + 1u) << 8u); }
static void wr16(thread Ctx& c, uint a, uint v) { wr8(c, a, v); wr8(c, a + 1u, v >> 8u); }
static uint rd32(thread Ctx& c, uint a) { return rd16(c, a) | (rd16(c, a + 2u) << 16u); }
static void wr32(thread Ctx& c, uint a, uint v) { wr16(c, a, v); wr16(c, a + 2u, v >> 16u); }

static CELLFN void c0_f_run(thread Ctx& c);
static CELLFN void c0_f_run(thread Ctx& c) {
    c.r0 = 0u; c.r1 = 0u; c.r2 = 0u; c.rw = 0u; c.rn = 0u;
    TICK
    TICK
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t1 = (uint)c.slots[0u];
    TICK
    uint t2 = (uint)c.slots[1u];
    if (t2 == 0u) { c.trap = 1u; return; }
    uint t3 = udiv(t1, t2) & 0xFFFFu;
    TICK
    uint t4 = (uint)c.slots[1u];
    uint t5 = (t3 * t4) & 0xFFFFu;
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t6 = (uint)c.slots[0u];
    TICK
    uint t7 = (uint)c.slots[1u];
    if (t7 == 0u) { c.trap = 1u; return; }
    uint t8 = urem(t6, t7) & 0xFFFFu;
    uint t9 = (t5 + t8) & 0xFFFFu;
    c.r0 = t9;
    c.rn = 1u;
}

kernel void cell_main(
    device const ushort* inp [[buffer(0)]],
    device ushort* outp [[buffer(1)]],
    device const uchar* cst [[buffer(2)]],
    constant uint& n_inputs [[buffer(3)]],
    device const uchar* stin [[buffer(4)]],
    device uchar* stout [[buffer(5)]],
    uint tid [[thread_position_in_grid]])
{

    uint idx = tid % n_inputs;
    Ctx c = {};
    c.fuel = 100000000u;
    uint r0 = 0u; uint r1 = 0u; uint r2 = 0u;

        c.cst_len = 0u;
        c.slot_bytes = 4u;
        c.slots[0u] = inp[idx * 3u + 0u];
        c.slots[1u] = inp[idx * 3u + 1u];
        c0_f_run(c);
        r0 = (c.rn > 0u) ? c.r0 : 0u;
        r1 = (c.rn > 1u) ? c.r1 : 0u;
        r2 = (c.rn > 2u) ? c.r2 : 0u;
        break; }
    }
    uint steps = 100000000u - c.fuel;
    if (c.trap != 0u) {
        r0 = (c.trap == 2u) ? (c.halt & 0xFFFFu) : 0u;
        r1 = 0u;
        r2 = 0u;
    }
    outp[tid * 6u + 0u] = (ushort)r0;
    outp[tid * 6u + 1u] = (ushort)r1;
    outp[tid * 6u + 2u] = (ushort)r2;
    outp[tid * 6u + 3u] = (ushort)c.trap;
    outp[tid * 6u + 4u] = (ushort)(steps & 0xFFFFu);
    outp[tid * 6u + 5u] = (ushort)(steps >> 16u);

==== cell e1_u32_arith ====
cell 0 entry=run params=3 ret_regs=2 wide_ret=true state_len=0

// generated by rustmsl — do not edit; semantics are the cell80-core interpreter's
#include <metal_stdlib>
using namespace metal;

struct Ctx {
    ushort slots[7];
    uchar state[1];
    device const uchar* cst;
    uint cst_len;
    uint slot_bytes;
    uint state_len;

static void wr8(thread Ctx& c, uint a, uint v) {
    a &= 0xFFFFu;
    if (a >= 0x9000u && a < 0x9000u + c.slot_bytes) {
        uint o = a - 0x9000u;
        uint i = o >> 1;
        uint sh = (o & 1u) * 8u;
        c.slots[i] = (ushort)(((uint)c.slots[i] & ~(0xFFu << sh)) | ((v & 0xFFu) << sh));
        return;
    }
    if (a >= 0xB000u && a < 0xB000u + c.state_len) {
        c.state[a - 0xB000u] = (uchar)(v & 0xFFu);
        return;
    }
    c.trap = 3u;
}
static uint rd16(thread Ctx& c, uint a) { return rd8(c, a) | (rd8(c, a + 1u) << 8u); }
static void wr16(thread Ctx& c, uint a, uint v) { wr8(c, a, v); wr8(c, a + 1u, v >> 8u); }
static uint rd32(thread Ctx& c, uint a) { return rd16(c, a) | (rd16(c, a + 2u) << 16u); }
static void wr32(thread Ctx& c, uint a, uint v) { wr16(c, a, v); wr16(c, a + 2u, v >> 16u); }

static CELLFN void c0_f_run(thread Ctx& c);
static CELLFN void c0_f_run(thread Ctx& c) {
    c.r0 = 0u; c.r1 = 0u; c.r2 = 0u; c.rw = 0u; c.rn = 0u;
    TICK
    TICK
    TICK
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t1 = (uint)c.slots[0u];
    uint t2 = t1 << 16u;
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t3 = (uint)c.slots[1u];
    uint t4 = t2 | t3;
    c.slots[3u] = (ushort)(t4 & 0xFFFFu);
    c.slots[4u] = (ushort)(t4 >> 16u);
    TICK
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t5 = (uint)c.slots[2u];
    c.slots[5u] = (ushort)(t5 & 0xFFFFu);
    c.slots[6u] = (ushort)(t5 >> 16u);
    TICK
    TICK
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t6 = (uint)c.slots[3u] | ((uint)c.slots[4u] << 16u);
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t7 = (uint)c.slots[5u] | ((uint)c.slots[6u] << 16u);
    TICK
    uint t8 = t7 + 1u;
    if (t8 == 0u) { c.trap = 1u; return; }
    uint t9 = udiv(t6, t8);
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t10 = (uint)c.slots[3u] | ((uint)c.slots[4u] << 16u);
    TICK
    uint t11 = (uint)c.slots[5u] | ((uint)c.slots[6u] << 16u);
    uint t12 = t10 * t11;
    uint t13 = t9 ^ t12;
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t14 = (uint)c.slots[3u] | ((uint)c.slots[4u] << 16u);
    uint t15 = t14 >> 5u;
    uint t16 = t13 ^ t15;
    c.rw = t16;
}

kernel void cell_main(
    device const ushort* inp [[buffer(0)]],
    device ushort* outp [[buffer(1)]],
    device const uchar* cst [[buffer(2)]],
    constant uint& n_inputs [[buffer(3)]],
    device const uchar* stin [[buffer(4)]],
    device uchar* stout [[buffer(5)]],
    uint tid [[thread_position_in_grid]])
{
    uint cell = tid / n_inputs;
    uint idx = tid % n_inputs;
    Ctx c = {};
    c.fuel = 100000000u;
    uint r0 = 0u; uint r1 = 0u; uint r2 = 0u;
    switch (cell) {
    case 0u: {
        c.cst = cst + 0u;
        c.cst_len = 0u;
        c.slot_bytes = 14u;
        c.slots[0u] = inp[idx * 3u + 0u];
        c.slots[1u] = inp[idx * 3u + 1u];
        c.slots[2u] = inp[idx * 3u + 2u];
        c0_f_run(c);
        r0 = c.rw & 0xFFFFu;
        r1 = c.rw >> 16u;
        break; }
    }
    uint steps = 100000000u - c.fuel;
    if (c.trap != 0u) {
        r0 = (c.trap == 2u) ? (c.halt & 0xFFFFu) : 0u;
        r1 = 0u;
        r2 = 0u;
    }
    outp[tid * 6u + 0u] = (ushort)r0;
    outp[tid * 6u + 1u] = (ushort)r1;
    outp[tid * 6u + 2u] = (ushort)r2;
    outp[tid * 6u + 3u] = (ushort)c.trap;
    outp[tid * 6u + 4u] = (ushort)(steps & 0xFFFFu);
    outp[tid * 6u + 5u] = (ushort)(steps >> 16u);
}

==== cell e1_i32_div ====
cell 0 entry=run params=2 ret_regs=2 wide_ret=true state_len=0
consts 
// generated by rustmsl — do not edit; semantics are the cell80-core interpreter's
#include <metal_stdlib>
using namespace metal;

struct Ctx {
    ushort slots[6];
    uchar state[1];
    device const uchar* cst;
    uint cst_len;
    uint slot_bytes;
    uint state_len;
    uint trap;
    uint halt;
    uint fuel;
    uint r0; uint r1; uint r2;
    uint rw;
    uint rn;
};

// The interpreter's tick(): one unit per statement, per expression
// node, per loop iteration; exhaustion is a trap, never a hang.
#define TICK if (--c.fuel == 0u) { c.trap = 4u; return; }
// Cell functions are pinned noinline: the shipped configuration is
// exactly the battery-validated one, not an inliner heuristic's.
#define CELLFN __attribute__((noinline))

// Sign-extend a masked 16-bit lane / bit-cast a 32-bit lane to signed.
static int sx16(uint x) { return (int)as_type<short>((ushort)(x)); }
static int sx32(uint x) { return as_type<int>(x); }

// Division rides opaque value-taking helpers: Metal's backend
// miscompiles a divide feeding a branch that guards stores through
// a thread-reference param (branch polarity inverts — caught by the
// E3 megakernel battery on `mul_sat`, minimised to a 10-line repro).
// The call boundary blocks the faulty fusion; zero-checks stay at
// the call site (the trap), and the signed MIN/-1 wrap lives here.
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint udiv(uint a, uint b) { return a / b; }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint urem(uint a, uint b) { return a % b; }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint sdiv16(uint a, uint b) { return ((uint)(sx16(a) / sx16(b))) & 0xFFFFu; }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint srem16(uint a, uint b) { return ((uint)(sx16(a) % sx16(b))) & 0xFFFFu; }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint sdiv32(uint a, uint b) { return (a == 0x80000000u && b == 0xFFFFFFFFu) ? a : (uint)(sx32(a) / sx32(b)); }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint srem32(uint a, uint b) { return (a == 0x80000000u && b == 0xFFFFFFFFu) ? 0u : (uint)(sx32(a) % sx32(b)); }

// Byte-routed window emulation: consts (read-only), the slot file,
// the state struct, else zero on read and a trap on write (the
// pre-registered E1 weakening).
static uint rd8(thread Ctx& c, uint a) {
    a &= 0xFFFFu;
    if (a >= 0x8000u && a < 0x8000u + c.cst_len) return (uint)c.cst[a - 0x8000u];
    if (a >= 0x9000u && a < 0x9000u + c.slot_bytes) {
        uint o = a - 0x9000u;
        return ((uint)c.slots[o >> 1] >> ((o & 1u) * 8u)) & 0xFFu;
    }
    if (a >= 0xB000u && a < 0xB000u + c.state_len) return (uint)c.state[a - 0xB000u];
    return 0u;
}
static void wr8(thread Ctx& c, uint a, uint v) {
    a &= 0xFFFFu;
    if (a >= 0x9000u && a < 0x9000u + c.slot_bytes) {
        uint o = a - 0x9000u;
        uint i = o >> 1;
        uint sh = (o & 1u) * 8u;
        c.slots[i] = (ushort)(((uint)c.slots[i] & ~(0xFFu << sh)) | ((v & 0xFFu) << sh));
        return;
    }
    if (a >= 0xB000u && a < 0xB000u + c.state_len) {
        c.state[a - 0xB000u] = (uchar)(v & 0xFFu);
        return;
    }
    c.trap = 3u;
}
static uint rd16(thread Ctx& c, uint a) { return rd8(c, a) | (rd8(c, a + 1u) << 8u); }
static void wr16(thread Ctx& c, uint a, uint v) { wr8(c, a, v); wr8(c, a + 1u, v >> 8u); }
static uint rd32(thread Ctx& c, uint a) { return rd16(c, a) | (rd16(c, a + 2u) << 16u); }
static void wr32(thread Ctx& c, uint a, uint v) { wr16(c, a, v); wr16(c, a + 2u, v >> 16u); }

static CELLFN void c0_f_run(thread Ctx& c);
static CELLFN void c0_f_run(thread Ctx& c) {
    c.r0 = 0u; c.r1 = 0u; c.r2 = 0u; c.rw = 0u; c.rn = 0u;
    TICK
    TICK
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t1 = (uint)c.slots[0u];
    uint t2 = (uint)sx16(t1);
    uint t3 = t2 << 16u;
    c.slots[2u] = (ushort)(t3 & 0xFFFFu);
    c.slots[3u] = (ushort)(t3 >> 16u);
    TICK
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t4 = (uint)c.slots[1u];
    uint t5 = (uint)sx16(t4);
    c.slots[4u] = (ushort)(t5 & 0xFFFFu);
    c.slots[5u] = (ushort)(t5 >> 16u);
    TICK
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t6 = (uint)c.slots[2u] | ((uint)c.slots[3u] << 16u);
    TICK
    uint t7 = (uint)c.slots[4u] | ((uint)c.slots[5u] << 16u);
    if (t7 == 0u) { c.trap = 1u; return; }
    uint t8 = sdiv32(t6, t7);
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t9 = (uint)c.slots[2u] | ((uint)c.slots[3u] << 16u);
    TICK
    uint t10 = (uint)c.slots[4u] | ((uint)c.slots[5u] << 16u);
    if (t10 == 0u) { c.trap = 1u; return; }
    uint t11 = srem32(t9, t10);
    uint t12 = t8 + t11;
    c.rw = t12;
}

        c.slot_bytes = 12u;

==== cell e1_shift_runtime ====

// generated by rustmsl — do not edit; semantics are the cell80-core interpreter's
#include <metal_stdlib>
using namespace metal;

struct Ctx {
    ushort slots[2];
    uchar state[1];
    device const uchar* cst;

    uint fuel;

    uint rw;
    uint rn;

static __attribute__((noinline)) uint srem32(uint a, uint b) { return (a == 0x80000000u && b == 0xFFFFFFFFu) ? 0u : (uint)(sx32(a) % sx32(b)); }

// Byte-routed window emulation: consts (read-only), the slot file,
// the state struct, else zero on read and a trap on write (the
// pre-registered E1 weakening).
static uint rd8(thread Ctx& c, uint a) {
    a &= 0xFFFFu;
    if (a >= 0x8000u && a < 0x8000u + c.cst_len) return (uint)c.cst[a - 0x8000u];
    if (a >= 0x9000u && a < 0x9000u + c.slot_bytes) {
        uint o = a - 0x9000u;
        return ((uint)c.slots[o >> 1] >> ((o & 1u) * 8u)) & 0xFFu;
    }
    if (a >= 0xB000u && a < 0xB000u + c.state_len) return (uint)c.state[a - 0xB000u];
    return 0u;
}
static void wr8(thread Ctx& c, uint a, uint v) {
    a &= 0xFFFFu;
    if (a >= 0x9000u && a < 0x9000u + c.slot_bytes) {
        uint o = a - 0x9000u;
        uint i = o >> 1;
        uint sh = (o & 1u) * 8u;
        c.slots[i] = (ushort)(((uint)c.slots[i] & ~(0xFFu << sh)) | ((v & 0xFFu) << sh));
        return;
    }
    if (a >= 0xB000u && a < 0xB000u + c.state_len) {
        c.state[a - 0xB000u] = (uchar)(v & 0xFFu);
        return;
    }
    c.trap = 3u;
}
static uint rd16(thread Ctx& c, uint a) { return rd8(c, a) | (rd8(c, a + 1u) << 8u); }

static uint rd32(thread Ctx& c, uint a) { return rd16(c, a) | (rd16(c, a + 2u) << 16u); }
static void wr32(thread Ctx& c, uint a, uint v) { wr16(c, a, v); wr16(c, a + 2u, v >> 16u); }

static CELLFN void c0_f_run(thread Ctx& c);
static CELLFN void c0_f_run(thread Ctx& c) {
    c.r0 = 0u; c.r1 = 0u; c.r2 = 0u; c.rw = 0u; c.rn = 0u;
    TICK
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t1 = (uint)c.slots[0u];
    TICK
    uint t2 = (uint)c.slots[1u];
    uint t3 = t2 & 0xFFu;
    uint t4 = (t3 > 31u) ? 0u : ((t1 << t3) & 0xFFFFu);
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t5 = (uint)c.slots[0u];
    TICK
    uint t6 = (uint)c.slots[1u];
    uint t7 = t6 & 0xFFu;
    uint t8 = (t7 > 15u) ? 0u : ((t5 >> t7) & 0xFFFFu);
    uint t9 = (t4 | t8) & 0xFFFFu;
    c.r0 = t9;
    c.rn = 1u;
}

kernel void cell_main(
    device const ushort* inp [[buffer(0)]],
    device ushort* outp [[buffer(1)]],
    device const uchar* cst [[buffer(2)]],
    constant uint& n_inputs [[buffer(3)]],
    device const uchar* stin [[buffer(4)]],
    device uchar* stout [[buffer(5)]],
    uint tid [[thread_position_in_grid]])
{
    uint cell = tid / n_inputs;
    uint idx = tid % n_inputs;
    Ctx c = {};
    c.fuel = 100000000u;
    uint r0 = 0u; uint r1 = 0u; uint r2 = 0u;
    switch (cell) {
    case 0u: {
        c.cst = cst + 0u;
        c.cst_len = 0u;
        c.slot_bytes = 4u;
        c.slots[0u] = inp[idx * 3u + 0u];
        c.slots[1u] = inp[idx * 3u + 1u];
        c0_f_run(c);
        r0 = (c.rn > 0u) ? c.r0 : 0u;
        r1 = (c.rn > 1u) ? c.r1 : 0u;
        r2 = (c.rn > 2u) ? c.r2 : 0u;
        break; }
    }
    uint steps = 100000000u - c.fuel;
    if (c.trap != 0u) {
        r0 = (c.trap == 2u) ? (c.halt & 0xFFFFu) : 0u;
        r1 = 0u;
        r2 = 0u;
    }
    outp[tid * 6u + 0u] = (ushort)r0;
    outp[tid * 6u + 1u] = (ushort)r1;
    outp[tid * 6u + 2u] = (ushort)r2;
    outp[tid * 6u + 3u] = (ushort)c.trap;
    outp[tid * 6u + 4u] = (ushort)(steps & 0xFFFFu);
    outp[tid * 6u + 5u] = (ushort)(steps >> 16u);
}

==== cell e1_shift_runtime_signed ====
cell 0 entry=run params=2 ret_regs=1 wide_ret=false state_len=0
consts 
// generated by rustmsl — do not edit; semantics are the cell80-core interpreter's
#include <metal_stdlib>
using namespace metal;

struct Ctx {
    ushort slots[2];
    uchar state[1];
    device const uchar* cst;
    uint cst_len;
    uint slot_bytes;
    uint state_len;
    uint trap;
    uint halt;
    uint fuel;
    uint r0; uint r1; uint r2;
    uint rw;
    uint rn;
};

// The interpreter's tick(): one unit per statement, per expression
// node, per loop iteration; exhaustion is a trap, never a hang.
#define TICK if (--c.fuel == 0u) { c.trap = 4u; return; }
// Cell functions are pinned noinline: the shipped configuration is
// exactly the battery-validated one, not an inliner heuristic's.
#define CELLFN __attribute__((noinline))

// Sign-extend a masked 16-bit lane / bit-cast a 32-bit lane to signed.
static int sx16(uint x) { return (int)as_type<short>((ushort)(x)); }
static int sx32(uint x) { return as_type<int>(x); }

// Division rides opaque value-taking helpers: Metal's backend
// miscompiles a divide feeding a branch that guards stores through
// a thread-reference param (branch polarity inverts — caught by the
// E3 megakernel battery on `mul_sat`, minimised to a 10-line repro).
// The call boundary blocks the faulty fusion; zero-checks stay at
// the call site (the trap), and the signed MIN/-1 wrap lives here.
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint udiv(uint a, uint b) { return a / b; }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint urem(uint a, uint b) { return a % b; }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint sdiv16(uint a, uint b) { return ((uint)(sx16(a) / sx16(b))) & 0xFFFFu; }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint srem16(uint a, uint b) { return ((uint)(sx16(a) % sx16(b))) & 0xFFFFu; }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint sdiv32(uint a, uint b) { return (a == 0x80000000u && b == 0xFFFFFFFFu) ? a : (uint)(sx32(a) / sx32(b)); }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint srem32(uint a, uint b) { return (a == 0x80000000u && b == 0xFFFFFFFFu) ? 0u : (uint)(sx32(a) % sx32(b)); }

// Byte-routed window emulation: consts (read-only), the slot file,
// the state struct, else zero on read and a trap on write (the
// pre-registered E1 weakening).
static uint rd8(thread Ctx& c, uint a) {
    a &= 0xFFFFu;
    if (a >= 0x8000u && a < 0x8000u + c.cst_len) return (uint)c.cst[a - 0x8000u];
    if (a >= 0x9000u && a < 0x9000u + c.slot_bytes) {
        uint o = a - 0x9000u;
        return ((uint)c.slots[o >> 1] >> ((o & 1u) * 8u)) & 0xFFu;
    }
    if (a >= 0xB000u && a < 0xB000u + c.state_len) return (uint)c.state[a - 0xB000u];
    return 0u;
}
static void wr8(thread Ctx& c, uint a, uint v) {
    a &= 0xFFFFu;
    if (a >= 0x9000u && a < 0x9000u + c.slot_bytes) {
        uint o = a - 0x9000u;
        uint i = o >> 1;
        uint sh = (o & 1u) * 8u;
        c.slots[i] = (ushort)(((uint)c.slots[i] & ~(0xFFu << sh)) | ((v & 0xFFu) << sh));
        return;
    }
    if (a >= 0xB000u && a < 0xB000u + c.state_len) {
        c.state[a - 0xB000u] = (uchar)(v & 0xFFu);
        return;
    }
    c.trap = 3u;
}
static uint rd16(thread Ctx& c, uint a) { return rd8(c, a) | (rd8(c, a + 1u) << 8u); }
static void wr16(thread Ctx& c, uint a, uint v) { wr8(c, a, v); wr8(c, a + 1u, v >> 8u); }
static uint rd32(thread Ctx& c, uint a) { return rd16(c, a) | (rd16(c, a + 2u) << 16u); }
static void wr32(thread Ctx& c, uint a, uint v) { wr16(c, a, v); wr16(c, a + 2u, v >> 16u); }

static CELLFN void c0_f_run(thread Ctx& c);
static CELLFN void c0_f_run(thread Ctx& c) {
    c.r0 = 0u; c.r1 = 0u; c.r2 = 0u; c.rw = 0u; c.rn = 0u;
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t1 = (uint)c.slots[0u];
    TICK
    uint t2 = (uint)c.slots[1u];
    uint t3 = t2 & 0xFFu;
    uint t4 = ((uint)(sx16(t1) >> (int)min(t3, 15u))) & 0xFFFFu;
    c.r0 = t4;
    c.rn = 1u;
}

kernel void cell_main(
    device const ushort* inp [[buffer(0)]],
    device ushort* outp [[buffer(1)]],
    device const uchar* cst [[buffer(2)]],
    constant uint& n_inputs [[buffer(3)]],
    device const uchar* stin [[buffer(4)]],
    device uchar* stout [[buffer(5)]],
    uint tid [[thread_position_in_grid]])
{
    uint cell = tid / n_inputs;
    uint idx = tid % n_inputs;
    Ctx c = {};
    c.fuel = 100000000u;
    uint r0 = 0u; uint r1 = 0u; uint r2 = 0u;
    switch (cell) {
    case 0u: {
        c.cst = cst + 0u;
        c.cst_len = 0u;
        c.slot_bytes = 4u;
        c.slots[0u] = inp[idx * 3u + 0u];
        c.slots[1u] = inp[idx * 3u + 1u];
        c0_f_run(c);
        r0 = (c.rn > 0u) ? c.r0 : 0u;
        r1 = (c.rn > 1u) ? c.r1 : 0u;
        r2 = (c.rn > 2u) ? c.r2 : 0u;
        break; }
    }
    uint steps = 100000000u - c.fuel;
    if (c.trap != 0u) {
        r0 = (c.trap == 2u) ? (c.halt & 0xFFFFu) : 0u;
        r1 = 0u;
        r2 = 0u;
    }
    outp[tid * 6u + 0u] = (ushort)r0;
    outp[tid * 6u + 1u] = (ushort)r1;
    outp[tid * 6u + 2u] = (ushort)r2;
    outp[tid * 6u + 3u] = (ushort)c.trap;
    outp[tid * 6u + 4u] = (ushort)(steps & 0xFFFFu);
    outp[tid * 6u + 5u] = (ushort)(steps >> 16u);
}

==== cell e1_shift_literal ====

// generated by rustmsl — do not edit; semantics are the cell80-core interpreter's
#include <metal_stdlib>
using namespace metal;

struct Ctx {
    ushort slots[1];
    uchar state[1];
    device const uchar* cst;

    uint slot_bytes;
    uint state_len;

// the state struct, else zero on read and a trap on write (the
// pre-registered E1 weakening).
static uint rd8(thread Ctx& c, uint a) {
    a &= 0xFFFFu;
    if (a >= 0x8000u && a < 0x8000u + c.cst_len) return (uint)c.cst[a - 0x8000u];
    if (a >= 0x9000u && a < 0x9000u + c.slot_bytes) {
        uint o = a - 0x9000u;
        return ((uint)c.slots[o >> 1] >> ((o & 1u) * 8u)) & 0xFFu;
    }
    if (a >= 0xB000u && a < 0xB000u + c.state_len) return (uint)c.state[a - 0xB000u];
    return 0u;
}
static void wr8(thread Ctx& c, uint a, uint v) {
    a &= 0xFFFFu;
    if (a >= 0x9000u && a < 0x9000u + c.slot_bytes) {
        uint o = a - 0x9000u;
        uint i = o >> 1;
        uint sh = (o & 1u) * 8u;
        c.slots[i] = (ushort)(((uint)c.slots[i] & ~(0xFFu << sh)) | ((v & 0xFFu) << sh));
        return;
    }
    if (a >= 0xB000u && a < 0xB000u + c.state_len) {
        c.state[a - 0xB000u] = (uchar)(v & 0xFFu);
        return;
    }

static CELLFN void c0_f_run(thread Ctx& c);
static CELLFN void c0_f_run(thread Ctx& c) {
    c.r0 = 0u; c.r1 = 0u; c.r2 = 0u; c.rw = 0u; c.rn = 0u;
    TICK
    TICK
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t1 = (uint)c.slots[0u];
    uint t2 = (t1 << 3u) & 0xFFFFu;
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t3 = (uint)c.slots[0u];
    uint t4 = (t3 >> 15u) & 0xFFFFu;
    uint t5 = (t2 ^ t4) & 0xFFFFu;
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t6 = (uint)c.slots[0u];
    uint t7 = (t6 << 15u) & 0xFFFFu;
    uint t8 = (t5 ^ t7) & 0xFFFFu;
    c.r0 = t8;
    c.rn = 1u;
}

kernel void cell_main(
    device const ushort* inp [[buffer(0)]],
    device ushort* outp [[buffer(1)]],
    device const uchar* cst [[buffer(2)]],
    constant uint& n_inputs [[buffer(3)]],
    device const uchar* stin [[buffer(4)]],
    device uchar* stout [[buffer(5)]],
    uint tid [[thread_position_in_grid]])
{
    uint cell = tid / n_inputs;
    uint idx = tid % n_inputs;

    c.fuel = 100000000u;
    uint r0 = 0u; uint r1 = 0u; uint r2 = 0u;

    case 0u: {
        c.cst = cst + 0u;
        c.cst_len = 0u;
        c.slot_bytes = 2u;
        c.slots[0u] = inp[idx * 3u + 0u];
        c0_f_run(c);
        r0 = (c.rn > 0u) ? c.r0 : 0u;
        r1 = (c.rn > 1u) ? c.r1 : 0u;
        r2 = (c.rn > 2u) ? c.r2 : 0u;

        r1 = 0u;
        r2 = 0u;

    outp[tid * 6u + 1u] = (ushort)r1;
    outp[tid * 6u + 2u] = (ushort)r2;
    outp[tid * 6u + 3u] = (ushort)c.trap;
    outp[tid * 6u + 4u] = (ushort)(steps & 0xFFFFu);
    outp[tid * 6u + 5u] = (ushort)(steps >> 16u);
}

==== cell e1_shift32_both ====

// pre-registered E1 weakening).
static uint rd8(thread Ctx& c, uint a) {

    if (a >= 0x9000u && a < 0x9000u + c.slot_bytes) {
        uint o = a - 0x9000u;
        return ((uint)c.slots[o >> 1] >> ((o & 1u) * 8u)) & 0xFFu;

    return 0u;

static void wr8(thread Ctx& c, uint a, uint v) {
    a &= 0xFFFFu;
    if (a >= 0x9000u && a < 0x9000u + c.slot_bytes) {
        uint o = a - 0x9000u;
        uint i = o >> 1;
        uint sh = (o & 1u) * 8u;
        c.slots[i] = (ushort)(((uint)c.slots[i] & ~(0xFFu << sh)) | ((v & 0xFFu) << sh));
        return;
    }
    if (a >= 0xB000u && a < 0xB000u + c.state_len) {
        c.state[a - 0xB000u] = (uchar)(v & 0xFFu);
        return;

static CELLFN void c0_f_run(thread Ctx& c);
static CELLFN void c0_f_run(thread Ctx& c) {
    c.r0 = 0u; c.r1 = 0u; c.r2 = 0u; c.rw = 0u; c.rn = 0u;
    TICK
    TICK
    TICK
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t1 = (uint)c.slots[0u];
    uint t2 = t1 << 16u;
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t3 = (uint)c.slots[1u];
    uint t4 = t2 | t3;
    c.slots[2u] = (ushort)(t4 & 0xFFFFu);
    c.slots[3u] = (ushort)(t4 >> 16u);
    TICK
    TICK
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t5 = (uint)c.slots[2u] | ((uint)c.slots[3u] << 16u);
    uint t6 = t5 << 3u;
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t7 = (uint)c.slots[2u] | ((uint)c.slots[3u] << 16u);
    uint t8 = t7 >> 7u;
    uint t9 = t6 ^ t8;
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t10 = (uint)c.slots[2u] | ((uint)c.slots[3u] << 16u);
    uint t11 = (uint)(sx32(t10) >> 5);
    uint t12 = t9 ^ t11;
    c.rw = t12;
}

kernel void cell_main(
    device const ushort* inp [[buffer(0)]],
    device ushort* outp [[buffer(1)]],
    device const uchar* cst [[buffer(2)]],
    constant uint& n_inputs [[buffer(3)]],
    device const uchar* stin [[buffer(4)]],
    device uchar* stout [[buffer(5)]],
    uint tid [[thread_position_in_grid]])
{

    uint idx = tid % n_inputs;

        c.cst_len = 0u;
        c.slot_bytes = 8u;
        c.slots[0u] = inp[idx * 3u + 0u];
        c.slots[1u] = inp[idx * 3u + 1u];
        c0_f_run(c);
        r0 = c.rw & 0xFFFFu;
        r1 = c.rw >> 16u;
        break; }
    }
    uint steps = 100000000u - c.fuel;
    if (c.trap != 0u) {
        r0 = (c.trap == 2u) ? (c.halt & 0xFFFFu) : 0u;
        r1 = 0u;
        r2 = 0u;
    }

    outp[tid * 6u + 1u] = (ushort)r1;
    outp[tid * 6u + 2u] = (ushort)r2;
    outp[tid * 6u + 3u] = (ushort)c.trap;
    outp[tid * 6u + 4u] = (ushort)(steps & 0xFFFFu);
    outp[tid * 6u + 5u] = (ushort)(steps >> 16u);
}

    if (a >= 0x8000u && a < 0x8000u + c.cst_len) return (uint)c.cst[a - 0x8000u];
    if (a >= 0x9000u && a < 0x9000u + c.slot_bytes) {
        uint o = a - 0x9000u;
        return ((uint)c.slots[o >> 1] >> ((o & 1u) * 8u)) & 0xFFu;
    }
    if (a >= 0xB000u && a < 0xB000u + c.state_len) return (uint)c.state[a - 0xB000u];
    return 0u;
}
static void wr8(thread Ctx& c, uint a, uint v) {
    a &= 0xFFFFu;
    if (a >= 0x9000u && a < 0x9000u + c.slot_bytes) {
        uint o = a - 0x9000u;
        uint i = o >> 1;
        uint sh = (o & 1u) * 8u;
        c.slots[i] = (ushort)(((uint)c.slots[i] & ~(0xFFu << sh)) | ((v & 0xFFu) << sh));
        return;
    }
    if (a >= 0xB000u && a < 0xB000u + c.state_len) {
        c.state[a - 0xB000u] = (uchar)(v & 0xFFu);
        return;
    }
    c.trap = 3u;
}
static uint rd16(thread Ctx& c, uint a) { return rd8(c, a) | (rd8(c, a + 1u) << 8u); }
static void wr16(thread Ctx& c, uint a, uint v) { wr8(c, a, v); wr8(c, a + 1u, v >> 8u); }
static uint rd32(thread Ctx& c, uint a) { return rd16(c, a) | (rd16(c, a + 2u) << 16u); }
static void wr32(thread Ctx& c, uint a, uint v) { wr16(c, a, v); wr16(c, a + 2u, v >> 16u); }

static CELLFN void c0_f_run(thread Ctx& c);
static CELLFN void c0_f_run(thread Ctx& c) {
    c.r0 = 0u; c.r1 = 0u; c.r2 = 0u; c.rw = 0u; c.rn = 0u;
    TICK
    TICK
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t1 = (uint)c.slots[0u];
    uint t2 = popcount(t1);
    TICK
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t3 = (uint)c.slots[0u];
    uint t4 = (t3 == 0u) ? 16u : (clz(t3) - 16u);
    uint t5 = (t4 << 5u) & 0xFFFFu;
    uint t6 = (t2 + t5) & 0xFFFFu;
    TICK
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t7 = (uint)c.slots[0u];
    uint t8 = (t7 == 0u) ? 16u : ctz(t7);
    uint t9 = (t8 << 10u) & 0xFFFFu;
    uint t10 = (t6 + t9) & 0xFFFFu;
    c.r0 = t10;
    c.rn = 1u;
}

kernel void cell_main(
    device const ushort* inp [[buffer(0)]],
    device ushort* outp [[buffer(1)]],
    device const uchar* cst [[buffer(2)]],
    constant uint& n_inputs [[buffer(3)]],
    device const uchar* stin [[buffer(4)]],
    device uchar* stout [[buffer(5)]],
    uint tid [[thread_position_in_grid]])
{
    uint cell = tid / n_inputs;
    uint idx = tid % n_inputs;
    Ctx c = {};
    c.fuel = 100000000u;
    uint r0 = 0u; uint r1 = 0u; uint r2 = 0u;
    switch (cell) {
    case 0u: {
        c.cst = cst + 0u;
        c.cst_len = 0u;
        c.slot_bytes = 2u;
        c.slots[0u] = inp[idx * 3u + 0u];
        c0_f_run(c);
        r0 = (c.rn > 0u) ? c.r0 : 0u;
        r1 = (c.rn > 1u) ? c.r1 : 0u;
        r2 = (c.rn > 2u) ? c.r2 : 0u;
        break; }
    }
    uint steps = 100000000u - c.fuel;
    if (c.trap != 0u) {
        r0 = (c.trap == 2u) ? (c.halt & 0xFFFFu) : 0u;
        r1 = 0u;
        r2 = 0u;
    }
    outp[tid * 6u + 0u] = (ushort)r0;
    outp[tid * 6u + 1u] = (ushort)r1;
    outp[tid * 6u + 2u] = (ushort)r2;
    outp[tid * 6u + 3u] = (ushort)c.trap;
    outp[tid * 6u + 4u] = (ushort)(steps & 0xFFFFu);
    outp[tid * 6u + 5u] = (ushort)(steps >> 16u);
}

==== cell e1_signed_compare ====
cell 0 entry=run params=2 ret_regs=1 wide_ret=false state_len=0
consts 
// generated by rustmsl — do not edit; semantics are the cell80-core interpreter's
#include <metal_stdlib>
using namespace metal;

struct Ctx {
    ushort slots[2];
    uchar state[1];
    device const uchar* cst;
    uint cst_len;
    uint slot_bytes;
    uint state_len;
    uint trap;
    uint halt;
    uint fuel;
    uint r0; uint r1; uint r2;
    uint rw;
    uint rn;
};

// The interpreter's tick(): one unit per statement, per expression
// node, per loop iteration; exhaustion is a trap, never a hang.
#define TICK if (--c.fuel == 0u) { c.trap = 4u; return; }
// Cell functions are pinned noinline: the shipped configuration is
// exactly the battery-validated one, not an inliner heuristic's.
#define CELLFN __attribute__((noinline))

// Sign-extend a masked 16-bit lane / bit-cast a 32-bit lane to signed.
static int sx16(uint x) { return (int)as_type<short>((ushort)(x)); }
static int sx32(uint x) { return as_type<int>(x); }

// Division rides opaque value-taking helpers: Metal's backend
// miscompiles a divide feeding a branch that guards stores through
// a thread-reference param (branch polarity inverts — caught by the
// E3 megakernel battery on `mul_sat`, minimised to a 10-line repro).
// The call boundary blocks the faulty fusion; zero-checks stay at
// the call site (the trap), and the signed MIN/-1 wrap lives here.
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint udiv(uint a, uint b) { return a / b; }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint urem(uint a, uint b) { return a % b; }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint sdiv16(uint a, uint b) { return ((uint)(sx16(a) / sx16(b))) & 0xFFFFu; }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint srem16(uint a, uint b) { return ((uint)(sx16(a) % sx16(b))) & 0xFFFFu; }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint sdiv32(uint a, uint b) { return (a == 0x80000000u && b == 0xFFFFFFFFu) ? a : (uint)(sx32(a) / sx32(b)); }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint srem32(uint a, uint b) { return (a == 0x80000000u && b == 0xFFFFFFFFu) ? 0u : (uint)(sx32(a) % sx32(b)); }

// Byte-routed window emulation: consts (read-only), the slot file,
// the state struct, else zero on read and a trap on write (the
// pre-registered E1 weakening).
static uint rd8(thread Ctx& c, uint a) {
    a &= 0xFFFFu;
    if (a >= 0x8000u && a < 0x8000u + c.cst_len) return (uint)c.cst[a - 0x8000u];
    if (a >= 0x9000u && a < 0x9000u + c.slot_bytes) {
        uint o = a - 0x9000u;
        return ((uint)c.slots[o >> 1] >> ((o & 1u) * 8u)) & 0xFFu;
    }
    if (a >= 0xB000u && a < 0xB000u + c.state_len) return (uint)c.state[a - 0xB000u];
    return 0u;
}
static void wr8(thread Ctx& c, uint a, uint v) {
    a &= 0xFFFFu;
    if (a >= 0x9000u && a < 0x9000u + c.slot_bytes) {
        uint o = a - 0x9000u;
        uint i = o >> 1;
        uint sh = (o & 1u) * 8u;
        c.slots[i] = (ushort)(((uint)c.slots[i] & ~(0xFFu << sh)) | ((v & 0xFFu) << sh));
        return;
    }
    if (a >= 0xB000u && a < 0xB000u + c.state_len) {
        c.state[a - 0xB000u] = (uchar)(v & 0xFFu);
        return;
    }
    c.trap = 3u;
}
static uint rd16(thread Ctx& c, uint a) { return rd8(c, a) | (rd8(c, a + 1u) << 8u); }
static void wr16(thread Ctx& c, uint a, uint v) { wr8(c, a, v); wr8(c, a + 1u, v >> 8u); }
static uint rd32(thread Ctx& c, uint a) { return rd16(c, a) | (rd16(c, a + 2u) << 16u); }
static void wr32(thread Ctx& c, uint a, uint v) { wr16(c, a, v); wr16(c, a + 2u, v >> 16u); }

static CELLFN void c0_f_run(thread Ctx& c);
static CELLFN void c0_f_run(thread Ctx& c) {
    c.r0 = 0u; c.r1 = 0u; c.r2 = 0u; c.rw = 0u; c.rn = 0u;
    TICK
    TICK
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t1 = (uint)c.slots[0u];
    TICK
    uint t2 = (uint)c.slots[1u];
    uint t3 = (sx16(t1) < sx16(t2)) ? 1u : 0u;
    TICK
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t4 = (uint)c.slots[0u];
    TICK
    uint t5 = (uint)c.slots[1u];
    uint t6 = (sx16(t4) >= sx16(t5)) ? 1u : 0u;
    uint t7 = (t6 << 1u) & 0xFFFFu;
    uint t8 = (t3 | t7) & 0xFFFFu;
    TICK
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t9 = (uint)c.slots[0u];
    TICK
    uint t10 = (uint)c.slots[1u];
    uint t11 = (t9 == t10) ? 1u : 0u;
    uint t12 = (t11 << 2u) & 0xFFFFu;
    uint t13 = (t8 | t12) & 0xFFFFu;
    c.r0 = t13;
    c.rn = 1u;
}

kernel void cell_main(
    device const ushort* inp [[buffer(0)]],
    device ushort* outp [[buffer(1)]],
    device const uchar* cst [[buffer(2)]],
    constant uint& n_inputs [[buffer(3)]],
    device const uchar* stin [[buffer(4)]],
    device uchar* stout [[buffer(5)]],

        r2 = (c.rn > 2u) ? c.r2 : 0u;
        break; }

==== cell e1_logic_shortcircuit ====

        return ((uint)c.slots[o >> 1] >> ((o & 1u) * 8u)) & 0xFFu;
    }

    return 0u;
}
static void wr8(thread Ctx& c, uint a, uint v) {
    a &= 0xFFFFu;
    if (a >= 0x9000u && a < 0x9000u + c.slot_bytes) {
        uint o = a - 0x9000u;
        uint i = o >> 1;
        uint sh = (o & 1u) * 8u;
        c.slots[i] = (ushort)(((uint)c.slots[i] & ~(0xFFu << sh)) | ((v & 0xFFu) << sh));
        return;
    }
    if (a >= 0xB000u && a < 0xB000u + c.state_len) {
        c.state[a - 0xB000u] = (uchar)(v & 0xFFu);
        return;
    }

static CELLFN void c0_f_run(thread Ctx& c);
static CELLFN void c0_f_run(thread Ctx& c) {
    c.r0 = 0u; c.r1 = 0u; c.r2 = 0u; c.rw = 0u; c.rn = 0u;
    TICK
    TICK
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t1 = (uint)c.slots[0u];
    TICK
    uint t2 = (t1 > 0u) ? 1u : 0u;
    uint t3 = t2;
    if (t3 != 0u) {
        TICK
        TICK
        TICK
        uint t4 = (uint)c.slots[1u];
        TICK
        uint t5 = (uint)c.slots[0u];
        if (t5 == 0u) { c.trap = 1u; return; }
        uint t6 = udiv(t4, t5) & 0xFFFFu;
        TICK
        uint t7 = (t6 > 2u) ? 1u : 0u;
        t3 = t7;
    }
    TICK
    if (t3 != 0u) {
        TICK
        TICK
        c.slots[2u] = (ushort)(1u);
    } else {
        TICK
        TICK
        c.slots[2u] = (ushort)(0u);
    }
    TICK
    uint t8 = (uint)c.slots[2u];
    c.r0 = t8;
    c.rn = 1u;
}

static CELLFN void c0_f_run(thread Ctx& c);
static CELLFN void c0_f_run(thread Ctx& c) {
    c.r0 = 0u; c.r1 = 0u; c.r2 = 0u; c.rw = 0u; c.rn = 0u;
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t1 = (uint)c.slots[0u];
    TICK
    if (t1 > 40000u) {
        TICK
        TICK
        TICK
        c.trap = 2u;
        c.halt = 7u;
        return;
        (void)0u;
    }
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t2 = (uint)c.slots[0u];
    TICK
    uint t3 = (t2 + 1u) & 0xFFFFu;
    c.r0 = t3;
    c.rn = 1u;
}

kernel void cell_main(
    device const ushort* inp [[buffer(0)]],
    device ushort* outp [[buffer(1)]],
    device const uchar* cst [[buffer(2)]],
    constant uint& n_inputs [[buffer(3)]],
    device const uchar* stin [[buffer(4)]],
    device uchar* stout [[buffer(5)]],
    uint tid [[thread_position_in_grid]])
{

    uint idx = tid % n_inputs;
    Ctx c = {};
    c.fuel = 100000000u;
    uint r0 = 0u; uint r1 = 0u; uint r2 = 0u;
    switch (cell) {
    case 0u: {
        c.cst = cst + 0u;
        c.cst_len = 0u;
        c.slot_bytes = 2u;
        c.slots[0u] = inp[idx * 3u + 0u];
        c0_f_run(c);
        r0 = (c.rn > 0u) ? c.r0 : 0u;
        r1 = (c.rn > 1u) ? c.r1 : 0u;
        r2 = (c.rn > 2u) ? c.r2 : 0u;
        break; }
    }
    uint steps = 100000000u - c.fuel;
    if (c.trap != 0u) {
        r0 = (c.trap == 2u) ? (c.halt & 0xFFFFu) : 0u;
        r1 = 0u;
        r2 = 0u;
    }
    outp[tid * 6u + 0u] = (ushort)r0;
    outp[tid * 6u + 1u] = (ushort)r1;
    outp[tid * 6u + 2u] = (ushort)r2;
    outp[tid * 6u + 3u] = (ushort)c.trap;
    outp[tid * 6u + 4u] = (ushort)(steps & 0xFFFFu);
    outp[tid * 6u + 5u] = (ushort)(steps >> 16u);
}

==== cell e1_tuple_return ====
cell 0 entry=run params=2 ret_regs=2 wide_ret=false state_len=0
consts 
// generated by rustmsl — do not edit; semantics are the cell80-core interpreter's
#include <metal_stdlib>
using namespace metal;

struct Ctx {
    ushort slots[4];
    uchar state[1];
    device const uchar* cst;
    uint cst_len;
    uint slot_bytes;
    uint state_len;
    uint trap;
    uint halt;
    uint fuel;
    uint r0; uint r1; uint r2;
    uint rw;
    uint rn;
};

// The interpreter's tick(): one unit per statement, per expression
// node, per loop iteration; exhaustion is a trap, never a hang.
#define TICK if (--c.fuel == 0u) { c.trap = 4u; return; }
// Cell functions are pinned noinline: the shipped configuration is
// exactly the battery-validated one, not an inliner heuristic's.
#define CELLFN __attribute__((noinline))

// Sign-extend a masked 16-bit lane / bit-cast a 32-bit lane to signed.
static int sx16(uint x) { return (int)as_type<short>((ushort)(x)); }
static int sx32(uint x) { return as_type<int>(x); }

// Division rides opaque value-taking helpers: Metal's backend
// miscompiles a divide feeding a branch that guards stores through
// a thread-reference param (branch polarity inverts — caught by the
// E3 megakernel battery on `mul_sat`, minimised to a 10-line repro).
// The call boundary blocks the faulty fusion; zero-checks stay at
// the call site (the trap), and the signed MIN/-1 wrap lives here.
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint udiv(uint a, uint b) { return a / b; }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint urem(uint a, uint b) { return a % b; }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint sdiv16(uint a, uint b) { return ((uint)(sx16(a) / sx16(b))) & 0xFFFFu; }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint srem16(uint a, uint b) { return ((uint)(sx16(a) % sx16(b))) & 0xFFFFu; }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint sdiv32(uint a, uint b) { return (a == 0x80000000u && b == 0xFFFFFFFFu) ? a : (uint)(sx32(a) / sx32(b)); }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint srem32(uint a, uint b) { return (a == 0x80000000u && b == 0xFFFFFFFFu) ? 0u : (uint)(sx32(a) % sx32(b)); }

// Byte-routed window emulation: consts (read-only), the slot file,
// the state struct, else zero on read and a trap on write (the
// pre-registered E1 weakening).
static uint rd8(thread Ctx& c, uint a) {
    a &= 0xFFFFu;
    if (a >= 0x8000u && a < 0x8000u + c.cst_len) return (uint)c.cst[a - 0x8000u];
    if (a >= 0x9000u && a < 0x9000u + c.slot_bytes) {
        uint o = a - 0x9000u;
        return ((uint)c.slots[o >> 1] >> ((o & 1u) * 8u)) & 0xFFu;
    }
    if (a >= 0xB000u && a < 0xB000u + c.state_len) return (uint)c.state[a - 0xB000u];
    return 0u;
}
static void wr8(thread Ctx& c, uint a, uint v) {
    a &= 0xFFFFu;
    if (a >= 0x9000u && a < 0x9000u + c.slot_bytes) {
        uint o = a - 0x9000u;
        uint i = o >> 1;
        uint sh = (o & 1u) * 8u;
        c.slots[i] = (ushort)(((uint)c.slots[i] & ~(0xFFu << sh)) | ((v & 0xFFu) << sh));
        return;
    }
    if (a >= 0xB000u && a < 0xB000u + c.state_len) {
        c.state[a - 0xB000u] = (uchar)(v & 0xFFu);
        return;
    }
    c.trap = 3u;
}
static uint rd16(thread Ctx& c, uint a) { return rd8(c, a) | (rd8(c, a + 1u) << 8u); }
static void wr16(thread Ctx& c, uint a, uint v) { wr8(c, a, v); wr8(c, a + 1u, v >> 8u); }
static uint rd32(thread Ctx& c, uint a) { return rd16(c, a) | (rd16(c, a + 2u) << 16u); }
static void wr32(thread Ctx& c, uint a, uint v) { wr16(c, a, v); wr16(c, a + 2u, v >> 16u); }

static CELLFN void c0_f_run(thread Ctx& c);
static CELLFN void c0_f_run(thread Ctx& c) {
    c.r0 = 0u; c.r1 = 0u; c.r2 = 0u; c.rw = 0u; c.rn = 0u;
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t1 = (uint)c.slots[0u];
    TICK
    uint t2 = (uint)c.slots[1u];
    if (t1 > t2) {
        TICK
        TICK
        uint t3 = (uint)c.slots[0u];
        c.slots[2u] = (ushort)(t3);
    } else {
        TICK
        TICK
        uint t4 = (uint)c.slots[1u];
        c.slots[2u] = (ushort)(t4);
    }
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t5 = (uint)c.slots[0u];
    TICK
    uint t6 = (uint)c.slots[1u];
    if (t5 > t6) {
        TICK
        TICK
        uint t7 = (uint)c.slots[1u];
        c.slots[3u] = (ushort)(t7);
    } else {
        TICK
        TICK
        uint t8 = (uint)c.slots[0u];
        c.slots[3u] = (ushort)(t8);
    }
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t9 = (uint)c.slots[2u];
    TICK
    uint t10 = (uint)c.slots[3u];
    uint t11 = (t9 - t10) & 0xFFFFu;
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t12 = (uint)c.slots[0u];
    TICK
    uint t13 = (uint)c.slots[1u];
    uint t14 = (t12 == t13) ? 1u : 0u;
    c.r0 = t11;
    c.r1 = t14;
    c.rn = 2u;
}

kernel void cell_main(
    device const ushort* inp [[buffer(0)]],
    device ushort* outp [[buffer(1)]],
    device const uchar* cst [[buffer(2)]],
    constant uint& n_inputs [[buffer(3)]],
    device const uchar* stin [[buffer(4)]],
    device uchar* stout [[buffer(5)]],
    uint tid [[thread_position_in_grid]])
{
    uint cell = tid / n_inputs;
    uint idx = tid % n_inputs;
    Ctx c = {};
    c.fuel = 100000000u;
    uint r0 = 0u; uint r1 = 0u; uint r2 = 0u;
    switch (cell) {
    case 0u: {
        c.cst = cst + 0u;
        c.cst_len = 0u;
        c.slot_bytes = 8u;
        c.slots[0u] = inp[idx * 3u + 0u];
        c.slots[1u] = inp[idx * 3u + 1u];
        c0_f_run(c);
        r0 = (c.rn > 0u) ? c.r0 : 0u;
        r1 = (c.rn > 1u) ? c.r1 : 0u;
        r2 = (c.rn > 2u) ? c.r2 : 0u;
        break; }
    }
    uint steps = 100000000u - c.fuel;
    if (c.trap != 0u) {
        r0 = (c.trap == 2u) ? (c.halt & 0xFFFFu) : 0u;
        r1 = 0u;
        r2 = 0u;
    }
    outp[tid * 6u + 0u] = (ushort)r0;
    outp[tid * 6u + 1u] = (ushort)r1;
    outp[tid * 6u + 2u] = (ushort)r2;
    outp[tid * 6u + 3u] = (ushort)c.trap;
    outp[tid * 6u + 4u] = (ushort)(steps & 0xFFFFu);
    outp[tid * 6u + 5u] = (ushort)(steps >> 16u);
}

static CELLFN void c0_f_pair(thread Ctx& c);
static CELLFN void c0_f_run(thread Ctx& c);
static CELLFN void c0_f_pair(thread Ctx& c) {
    c.r0 = 0u; c.r1 = 0u; c.r2 = 0u; c.rw = 0u; c.rn = 0u;
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t1 = (uint)c.slots[0u];
    TICK
    uint t2 = (t1 + 1u) & 0xFFFFu;
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t3 = (uint)c.slots[0u];
    TICK
    uint t4 = (t3 * 2u) & 0xFFFFu;
    c.r0 = t2;
    c.r1 = t4;
    c.rn = 2u;
}

static CELLFN void c0_f_run(thread Ctx& c) {
    c.r0 = 0u; c.r1 = 0u; c.r2 = 0u; c.rw = 0u; c.rn = 0u;
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t5 = (uint)c.slots[1u];
    c.slots[0u] = (ushort)(t5);
    c0_f_pair(c);
    if (c.trap != 0u) { return; }
    if (c.rn > 0u) { c.slots[2u] = (ushort)c.r0; }
    if (c.rn > 1u) { c.slots[3u] = (ushort)c.r1; }
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t6 = (uint)c.slots[2u];
    TICK
    uint t7 = (uint)c.slots[3u];
    uint t8 = (t6 + t7) & 0xFFFFu;
    c.r0 = t8;
    c.rn = 1u;
}

==== cell e1_helper_calls ====

// generated by rustmsl — do not edit; semantics are the cell80-core interpreter's
#include <metal_stdlib>
using namespace metal;

struct Ctx {
    ushort slots[6];
    uchar state[1];
    device const uchar* cst;
    uint cst_len;
    uint slot_bytes;
    uint state_len;
    uint trap;
    uint halt;
    uint fuel;
    uint r0; uint r1; uint r2;
    uint rw;
    uint rn;
};

// The interpreter's tick(): one unit per statement, per expression
// node, per loop iteration; exhaustion is a trap, never a hang.

static __attribute__((noinline)) uint srem32(uint a, uint b) { return (a == 0x80000000u && b == 0xFFFFFFFFu) ? 0u : (uint)(sx32(a) % sx32(b)); }

// Byte-routed window emulation: consts (read-only), the slot file,
// the state struct, else zero on read and a trap on write (the
// pre-registered E1 weakening).
static uint rd8(thread Ctx& c, uint a) {
    a &= 0xFFFFu;
    if (a >= 0x8000u && a < 0x8000u + c.cst_len) return (uint)c.cst[a - 0x8000u];
    if (a >= 0x9000u && a < 0x9000u + c.slot_bytes) {
        uint o = a - 0x9000u;
        return ((uint)c.slots[o >> 1] >> ((o & 1u) * 8u)) & 0xFFu;
    }
    if (a >= 0xB000u && a < 0xB000u + c.state_len) return (uint)c.state[a - 0xB000u];
    return 0u;
}
static void wr8(thread Ctx& c, uint a, uint v) {
    a &= 0xFFFFu;
    if (a >= 0x9000u && a < 0x9000u + c.slot_bytes) {
        uint o = a - 0x9000u;
        uint i = o >> 1;
        uint sh = (o & 1u) * 8u;
        c.slots[i] = (ushort)(((uint)c.slots[i] & ~(0xFFu << sh)) | ((v & 0xFFu) << sh));
        return;
    }
    if (a >= 0xB000u && a < 0xB000u + c.state_len) {
        c.state[a - 0xB000u] = (uchar)(v & 0xFFu);
        return;
    }
    c.trap = 3u;
}
static uint rd16(thread Ctx& c, uint a) { return rd8(c, a) | (rd8(c, a + 1u) << 8u); }
static void wr16(thread Ctx& c, uint a, uint v) { wr8(c, a, v); wr8(c, a + 1u, v >> 8u); }
static uint rd32(thread Ctx& c, uint a) { return rd16(c, a) | (rd16(c, a + 2u) << 16u); }
static void wr32(thread Ctx& c, uint a, uint v) { wr16(c, a, v); wr16(c, a + 2u, v >> 16u); }

static CELLFN void c0_f_diff(thread Ctx& c);
static CELLFN void c0_f_run(thread Ctx& c);
static CELLFN void c0_f_diff(thread Ctx& c) {
    c.r0 = 0u; c.r1 = 0u; c.r2 = 0u; c.rw = 0u; c.rn = 0u;
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t1 = (uint)c.slots[0u];
    TICK
    uint t2 = (uint)c.slots[1u];
    if (sx16(t1) > sx16(t2)) {
        TICK
        TICK
        TICK
        uint t3 = (uint)c.slots[0u];
        TICK
        uint t4 = (uint)c.slots[1u];
        uint t5 = (t3 - t4) & 0xFFFFu;
        c.slots[2u] = (ushort)(t5);
    } else {
        TICK
        TICK
        TICK
        uint t6 = (uint)c.slots[1u];
        TICK
        uint t7 = (uint)c.slots[0u];
        uint t8 = (t6 - t7) & 0xFFFFu;
        c.slots[2u] = (ushort)(t8);
    }
    TICK
    uint t9 = (uint)c.slots[2u];
    c.r0 = t9;
    c.rn = 1u;
}

static CELLFN void c0_f_run(thread Ctx& c) {
    c.r0 = 0u; c.r1 = 0u; c.r2 = 0u; c.rw = 0u; c.rn = 0u;
    TICK
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t10 = (uint)c.slots[3u];
    TICK
    uint t11 = (uint)c.slots[4u];
    c.slots[0u] = (ushort)(t10);
    c.slots[1u] = (ushort)(t11);
    c0_f_diff(c);
    if (c.trap != 0u) { return; }
    uint t12 = (c.rn > 0u) ? c.r0 : 0u;
    TICK
    uint t13 = (uint)c.slots[5u];
    c.slots[0u] = (ushort)(t12);
    c.slots[1u] = (ushort)(t13);
    c0_f_diff(c);
    if (c.trap != 0u) { return; }
    uint t14 = (c.rn > 0u) ? c.r0 : 0u;
    c.r0 = t14;
    c.rn = 1u;
}

kernel void cell_main(
    device const ushort* inp [[buffer(0)]],
    device ushort* outp [[buffer(1)]],
    device const uchar* cst [[buffer(2)]],
    constant uint& n_inputs [[buffer(3)]],
    device const uchar* stin [[buffer(4)]],
    device uchar* stout [[buffer(5)]],
    uint tid [[thread_position_in_grid]])

    case 0u: {
        c.cst = cst + 0u;
        c.cst_len = 0u;
        c.slot_bytes = 12u;
        c.slots[3u] = inp[idx * 3u + 0u];
        c.slots[4u] = inp[idx * 3u + 1u];
        c.slots[5u] = inp[idx * 3u + 2u];
        c0_f_run(c);
        r0 = (c.rn > 0u) ? c.r0 : 0u;
        r1 = (c.rn > 1u) ? c.r1 : 0u;

        r0 = (c.trap == 2u) ? (c.halt & 0xFFFFu) : 0u;
        r1 = 0u;
        r2 = 0u;
    }
    outp[tid * 6u + 0u] = (ushort)r0;
    outp[tid * 6u + 1u] = (ushort)r1;
    outp[tid * 6u + 2u] = (ushort)r2;
    outp[tid * 6u + 3u] = (ushort)c.trap;
    outp[tid * 6u + 4u] = (ushort)(steps & 0xFFFFu);
    outp[tid * 6u + 5u] = (ushort)(steps >> 16u);
}

==== cell e1_wide_param_call ====
cell 0 entry=run params=2 ret_regs=2 wide_ret=true state_len=0
consts 
// generated by rustmsl — do not edit; semantics are the cell80-core interpreter's
#include <metal_stdlib>
using namespace metal;

struct Ctx {
    ushort slots[5];
    uchar state[1];
    device const uchar* cst;
    uint cst_len;
    uint slot_bytes;
    uint state_len;
    uint trap;
    uint halt;
    uint fuel;
    uint r0; uint r1; uint r2;
    uint rw;
    uint rn;
};

// The interpreter's tick(): one unit per statement, per expression
// node, per loop iteration; exhaustion is a trap, never a hang.
#define TICK if (--c.fuel == 0u) { c.trap = 4u; return; }
// Cell functions are pinned noinline: the shipped configuration is
// exactly the battery-validated one, not an inliner heuristic's.
#define CELLFN __attribute__((noinline))

// Sign-extend a masked 16-bit lane / bit-cast a 32-bit lane to signed.
static int sx16(uint x) { return (int)as_type<short>((ushort)(x)); }
static int sx32(uint x) { return as_type<int>(x); }

// Division rides opaque value-taking helpers: Metal's backend
// miscompiles a divide feeding a branch that guards stores through
// a thread-reference param (branch polarity inverts — caught by the
// E3 megakernel battery on `mul_sat`, minimised to a 10-line repro).
// The call boundary blocks the faulty fusion; zero-checks stay at
// the call site (the trap), and the signed MIN/-1 wrap lives here.
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint udiv(uint a, uint b) { return a / b; }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint urem(uint a, uint b) { return a % b; }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint sdiv16(uint a, uint b) { return ((uint)(sx16(a) / sx16(b))) & 0xFFFFu; }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint srem16(uint a, uint b) { return ((uint)(sx16(a) % sx16(b))) & 0xFFFFu; }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint sdiv32(uint a, uint b) { return (a == 0x80000000u && b == 0xFFFFFFFFu) ? a : (uint)(sx32(a) / sx32(b)); }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint srem32(uint a, uint b) { return (a == 0x80000000u && b == 0xFFFFFFFFu) ? 0u : (uint)(sx32(a) % sx32(b)); }

// Byte-routed window emulation: consts (read-only), the slot file,
// the state struct, else zero on read and a trap on write (the
// pre-registered E1 weakening).
static uint rd8(thread Ctx& c, uint a) {
    a &= 0xFFFFu;
    if (a >= 0x8000u && a < 0x8000u + c.cst_len) return (uint)c.cst[a - 0x8000u];
    if (a >= 0x9000u && a < 0x9000u + c.slot_bytes) {
        uint o = a - 0x9000u;
        return ((uint)c.slots[o >> 1] >> ((o & 1u) * 8u)) & 0xFFu;
    }
    if (a >= 0xB000u && a < 0xB000u + c.state_len) return (uint)c.state[a - 0xB000u];
    return 0u;
}
static void wr8(thread Ctx& c, uint a, uint v) {
    a &= 0xFFFFu;
    if (a >= 0x9000u && a < 0x9000u + c.slot_bytes) {
        uint o = a - 0x9000u;
        uint i = o >> 1;
        uint sh = (o & 1u) * 8u;
        c.slots[i] = (ushort)(((uint)c.slots[i] & ~(0xFFu << sh)) | ((v & 0xFFu) << sh));
        return;
    }
    if (a >= 0xB000u && a < 0xB000u + c.state_len) {
        c.state[a - 0xB000u] = (uchar)(v & 0xFFu);
        return;
    }
    c.trap = 3u;
}
static uint rd16(thread Ctx& c, uint a) { return rd8(c, a) | (rd8(c, a + 1u) << 8u); }
static void wr16(thread Ctx& c, uint a, uint v) { wr8(c, a, v); wr8(c, a + 1u, v >> 8u); }
static uint rd32(thread Ctx& c, uint a) { return rd16(c, a) | (rd16(c, a + 2u) << 16u); }
static void wr32(thread Ctx& c, uint a, uint v) { wr16(c, a, v); wr16(c, a + 2u, v >> 16u); }

static CELLFN void c0_f_wide(thread Ctx& c);
static CELLFN void c0_f_run(thread Ctx& c);
static CELLFN void c0_f_wide(thread Ctx& c) {
    c.r0 = 0u; c.r1 = 0u; c.r2 = 0u; c.rw = 0u; c.rn = 0u;
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t1 = (uint)c.slots[0u] | ((uint)c.slots[1u] << 16u);
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t2 = (uint)c.slots[2u];
    uint t3 = t1 + t2;
    c.rw = t3;
}

static CELLFN void c0_f_run(thread Ctx& c) {
    c.r0 = 0u; c.r1 = 0u; c.r2 = 0u; c.rw = 0u; c.rn = 0u;
    TICK
    TICK
    TICK
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t4 = (uint)c.slots[3u];
    uint t5 = t4 << 16u;
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t6 = (uint)c.slots[4u];
    uint t7 = t5 | t6;
    TICK
    uint t8 = (uint)c.slots[3u];
    c.slots[0u] = (ushort)(t7 & 0xFFFFu);
    c.slots[1u] = (ushort)(t7 >> 16u);
    c.slots[2u] = (ushort)(t8);
    c0_f_wide(c);
    if (c.trap != 0u) { return; }
    uint t9 = c.rw;
    c.rw = t9;
}

kernel void cell_main(
    device const ushort* inp [[buffer(0)]],
    device ushort* outp [[buffer(1)]],
    device const uchar* cst [[buffer(2)]],
    constant uint& n_inputs [[buffer(3)]],
    device const uchar* stin [[buffer(4)]],
    device uchar* stout [[buffer(5)]],
    uint tid [[thread_position_in_grid]])
{
    uint cell = tid / n_inputs;
    uint idx = tid % n_inputs;
    Ctx c = {};
    c.fuel = 100000000u;
    uint r0 = 0u; uint r1 = 0u; uint r2 = 0u;
    switch (cell) {
    case 0u: {
        c.cst = cst + 0u;
        c.cst_len = 0u;
        c.slot_bytes = 10u;
        c.slots[3u] = inp[idx * 3u + 0u];
        c.slots[4u] = inp[idx * 3u + 1u];
        c0_f_run(c);
        r0 = c.rw & 0xFFFFu;
        r1 = c.rw >> 16u;
        break; }
    }
    uint steps = 100000000u - c.fuel;
    if (c.trap != 0u) {
        r0 = (c.trap == 2u) ? (c.halt & 0xFFFFu) : 0u;
        r1 = 0u;
        r2 = 0u;
    }
    outp[tid * 6u + 0u] = (ushort)r0;
    outp[tid * 6u + 1u] = (ushort)r1;
    outp[tid * 6u + 2u] = (ushort)r2;
    outp[tid * 6u + 3u] = (ushort)c.trap;
    outp[tid * 6u + 4u] = (ushort)(steps & 0xFFFFu);
    outp[tid * 6u + 5u] = (ushort)(steps >> 16u);
}

==== cell e2_gcd_while ====

    if (a >= 0x8000u && a < 0x8000u + c.cst_len) return (uint)c.cst[a - 0x8000u];
    if (a >= 0x9000u && a < 0x9000u + c.slot_bytes) {
        uint o = a - 0x9000u;
        return ((uint)c.slots[o >> 1] >> ((o & 1u) * 8u)) & 0xFFu;
    }
    if (a >= 0xB000u && a < 0xB000u + c.state_len) return (uint)c.state[a - 0xB000u];
    return 0u;
}
static void wr8(thread Ctx& c, uint a, uint v) {
    a &= 0xFFFFu;
    if (a >= 0x9000u && a < 0x9000u + c.slot_bytes) {
        uint o = a - 0x9000u;
        uint i = o >> 1;
        uint sh = (o & 1u) * 8u;
        c.slots[i] = (ushort)(((uint)c.slots[i] & ~(0xFFu << sh)) | ((v & 0xFFu) << sh));
        return;
    }
    if (a >= 0xB000u && a < 0xB000u + c.state_len) {
        c.state[a - 0xB000u] = (uchar)(v & 0xFFu);
        return;
    }

static CELLFN void c0_f_run(thread Ctx& c);
static CELLFN void c0_f_run(thread Ctx& c) {
    c.r0 = 0u; c.r1 = 0u; c.r2 = 0u; c.rw = 0u; c.rn = 0u;
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t1 = (uint)c.slots[0u];
    c.slots[2u] = (ushort)(t1);
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t2 = (uint)c.slots[1u];
    c.slots[3u] = (ushort)(t2);
    TICK
    for (;;) {
        TICK
        TICK
        uint t3 = (uint)c.slots[3u];
        TICK
        if (!(t3 != 0u)) break;
        TICK
        TICK
        TICK
        uint t4 = (uint)c.slots[2u];
        TICK
        uint t5 = (uint)c.slots[3u];
        if (t5 == 0u) { c.trap = 1u; return; }
        uint t6 = urem(t4, t5) & 0xFFFFu;
        c.slots[4u] = (ushort)(t6);
        TICK
        TICK
        uint t7 = (uint)c.slots[3u];
        c.slots[2u] = (ushort)(t7);
        TICK
        TICK
        uint t8 = (uint)c.slots[4u];
        c.slots[3u] = (ushort)(t8);
    }
    TICK
    uint t9 = (uint)c.slots[2u];
    c.r0 = t9;
    c.rn = 1u;
}

kernel void cell_main(
    device const ushort* inp [[buffer(0)]],
    device ushort* outp [[buffer(1)]],
    device const uchar* cst [[buffer(2)]],
    constant uint& n_inputs [[buffer(3)]],
    device const uchar* stin [[buffer(4)]],
    device uchar* stout [[buffer(5)]],
    uint tid [[thread_position_in_grid]])
{
    uint cell = tid / n_inputs;
    uint idx = tid % n_inputs;
    Ctx c = {};
    c.fuel = 100000000u;
    uint r0 = 0u; uint r1 = 0u; uint r2 = 0u;
    switch (cell) {
    case 0u: {
        c.cst = cst + 0u;
        c.cst_len = 0u;
        c.slot_bytes = 10u;
        c.slots[0u] = inp[idx * 3u + 0u];
        c.slots[1u] = inp[idx * 3u + 1u];
        c0_f_run(c);
        r0 = (c.rn > 0u) ? c.r0 : 0u;
        r1 = (c.rn > 1u) ? c.r1 : 0u;
        r2 = (c.rn > 2u) ? c.r2 : 0u;
        break; }
    }
    uint steps = 100000000u - c.fuel;
    if (c.trap != 0u) {
        r0 = (c.trap == 2u) ? (c.halt & 0xFFFFu) : 0u;
        r1 = 0u;
        r2 = 0u;
    }
    outp[tid * 6u + 0u] = (ushort)r0;
    outp[tid * 6u + 1u] = (ushort)r1;
    outp[tid * 6u + 2u] = (ushort)r2;
    outp[tid * 6u + 3u] = (ushort)c.trap;
    outp[tid * 6u + 4u] = (ushort)(steps & 0xFFFFu);
    outp[tid * 6u + 5u] = (ushort)(steps >> 16u);
}

==== cell e2_for_continue ====
cell 0 entry=run params=2 ret_regs=1 wide_ret=false state_len=0

// generated by rustmsl — do not edit; semantics are the cell80-core interpreter's
#include <metal_stdlib>
using namespace metal;

struct Ctx {
    ushort slots[5];
    uchar state[1];
    device const uchar* cst;
    uint cst_len;
    uint slot_bytes;
    uint state_len;
    uint trap;
    uint halt;
    uint fuel;
    uint r0; uint r1; uint r2;
    uint rw;
    uint rn;
};

// The interpreter's tick(): one unit per statement, per expression
// node, per loop iteration; exhaustion is a trap, never a hang.
#define TICK if (--c.fuel == 0u) { c.trap = 4u; return; }
// Cell functions are pinned noinline: the shipped configuration is
// exactly the battery-validated one, not an inliner heuristic's.
#define CELLFN __attribute__((noinline))

// the call site (the trap), and the signed MIN/-1 wrap lives here.

static __attribute__((noinline)) uint urem(uint a, uint b) { return a % b; }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint sdiv16(uint a, uint b) { return ((uint)(sx16(a) / sx16(b))) & 0xFFFFu; }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint srem16(uint a, uint b) { return ((uint)(sx16(a) % sx16(b))) & 0xFFFFu; }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint sdiv32(uint a, uint b) { return (a == 0x80000000u && b == 0xFFFFFFFFu) ? a : (uint)(sx32(a) / sx32(b)); }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint srem32(uint a, uint b) { return (a == 0x80000000u && b == 0xFFFFFFFFu) ? 0u : (uint)(sx32(a) % sx32(b)); }

// Byte-routed window emulation: consts (read-only), the slot file,
// the state struct, else zero on read and a trap on write (the
// pre-registered E1 weakening).
static uint rd8(thread Ctx& c, uint a) {
    a &= 0xFFFFu;
    if (a >= 0x8000u && a < 0x8000u + c.cst_len) return (uint)c.cst[a - 0x8000u];
    if (a >= 0x9000u && a < 0x9000u + c.slot_bytes) {
        uint o = a - 0x9000u;
        return ((uint)c.slots[o >> 1] >> ((o & 1u) * 8u)) & 0xFFu;
    }
    if (a >= 0xB000u && a < 0xB000u + c.state_len) return (uint)c.state[a - 0xB000u];
    return 0u;
}
static void wr8(thread Ctx& c, uint a, uint v) {
    a &= 0xFFFFu;
    if (a >= 0x9000u && a < 0x9000u + c.slot_bytes) {
        uint o = a - 0x9000u;
        uint i = o >> 1;
        uint sh = (o & 1u) * 8u;
        c.slots[i] = (ushort)(((uint)c.slots[i] & ~(0xFFu << sh)) | ((v & 0xFFu) << sh));
        return;
    }
    if (a >= 0xB000u && a < 0xB000u + c.state_len) {
        c.state[a - 0xB000u] = (uchar)(v & 0xFFu);
        return;
    }
    c.trap = 3u;
}
static uint rd16(thread Ctx& c, uint a) { return rd8(c, a) | (rd8(c, a + 1u) << 8u); }

static uint rd32(thread Ctx& c, uint a) { return rd16(c, a) | (rd16(c, a + 2u) << 16u); }
static void wr32(thread Ctx& c, uint a, uint v) { wr16(c, a, v); wr16(c, a + 2u, v >> 16u); }

static CELLFN void c0_f_run(thread Ctx& c);
static CELLFN void c0_f_run(thread Ctx& c) {
    c.r0 = 0u; c.r1 = 0u; c.r2 = 0u; c.rw = 0u; c.rn = 0u;
    TICK
    TICK
    c.slots[2u] = (ushort)(0u);
    TICK
    TICK
    c.slots[4u] = (ushort)(0u);
    TICK
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t1 = (uint)c.slots[0u];
    TICK
    uint t2 = (t1 & 127u) & 0xFFFFu;
    c.slots[3u] = (ushort)(t2);
    TICK
    for (;;) {
        TICK
        uint t3 = (uint)c.slots[4u];
        TICK
        uint t4 = (uint)c.slots[3u];
        if (!(t3 < t4)) break;
        uint t5 = 0u;
        do {
            TICK
            TICK
            TICK
            uint t6 = (uint)c.slots[4u];
            TICK
            if (3u == 0u) { c.trap = 1u; return; }
            uint t7 = urem(t6, 3u) & 0xFFFFu;
            TICK
            if (t7 == 0u) {
                TICK
                continue;
            }
            TICK
            TICK
            uint t8 = (uint)c.slots[4u];
            TICK
            uint t9 = (uint)c.slots[1u];
            if (t8 == t9) {
                TICK
                continue;
            }
            TICK
            TICK
            TICK
            uint t10 = (uint)c.slots[2u];
            TICK
            uint t11 = (uint)c.slots[4u];
            uint t12 = (t10 + t11) & 0xFFFFu;
            c.slots[2u] = (ushort)(t12);
        } while (false);
        if (t5 != 0u) break;
        c.slots[4u] = (ushort)(((uint)c.slots[4u] + 1u) & 0xFFFFu);
    }
    TICK
    uint t13 = (uint)c.slots[2u];
    c.r0 = t13;
    c.rn = 1u;
}

    device const ushort* inp [[buffer(0)]],
    device ushort* outp [[buffer(1)]],

    device const uchar* stin [[buffer(4)]],
    device uchar* stout [[buffer(5)]],

        r1 = (c.rn > 1u) ? c.r1 : 0u;

==== cell e2_nested_break ====

#include <metal_stdlib>
