// miscompiles a divide feeding a branch that guards stores through
// a thread-reference param (branch polarity inverts — caught by the
// E3 megakernel battery on `mul_sat`, minimised to a 10-line repro).
// The call boundary blocks the faulty fusion; zero-checks stay at
// the call site (the trap), and the signed MIN/-1 wrap lives here.
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint udiv(uint a, uint b) { return a / b; }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint urem(uint a, uint b) { return a % b; }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint sdiv16(uint a, uint b) { return ((uint)(sx16(a) / sx16(b))) & 0xFFFFu; }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint srem16(uint a, uint b) { return ((uint)(sx16(a) % sx16(b))) & 0xFFFFu; }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint sdiv32(uint a, uint b) { return (a == 0x80000000u && b == 0xFFFFFFFFu) ? a : (uint)(sx32(a) / sx32(b)); }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint srem32(uint a, uint b) { return (a == 0x80000000u && b == 0xFFFFFFFFu) ? 0u : (uint)(sx32(a) % sx32(b)); }

// Byte-routed window emulation: consts (read-only), the slot file,
// the state struct, else zero on read and a trap on write (the
// pre-registered E1 weakening).
static uint rd8(thread Ctx& c, uint a) {
    a &= 0xFFFFu;
    if (a >= 0x8000u && a < 0x8000u + c.cst_len) return (uint)c.cst[a - 0x8000u];
    if (a >= 0x9000u && a < 0x9000u + c.slot_bytes) {
        uint o = a - 0x9000u;
        return ((uint)c.slots[o >> 1] >> ((o & 1u) * 8u)) & 0xFFu;
    }
    if (a >= 0xB000u && a < 0xB000u + c.state_len) return (uint)c.state[a - 0xB000u];
    return 0u;
}
static void wr8(thread Ctx& c, uint a, uint v) {
    a &= 0xFFFFu;
    if (a >= 0x9000u && a < 0x9000u + c.slot_bytes) {
        uint o = a - 0x9000u;
        uint i = o >> 1;
        uint sh = (o & 1u) * 8u;
        c.slots[i] = (ushort)(((uint)c.slots[i] & ~(0xFFu << sh)) | ((v & 0xFFu) << sh));
        return;
    }
    if (a >= 0xB000u && a < 0xB000u + c.state_len) {
        c.state[a - 0xB000u] = (uchar)(v & 0xFFu);
        return;
    }
    c.trap = 3u;
}
static uint rd16(thread Ctx& c, uint a) { return rd8(c, a) | (rd8(c, a + 1u) << 8u); }
static void wr16(thread Ctx& c, uint a, uint v) { wr8(c, a, v); wr8(c, a + 1u, v >> 8u); }
static uint rd32(thread Ctx& c, uint a) { return rd16(c, a) | (rd16(c, a + 2u) << 16u); }
static void wr32(thread Ctx& c, uint a, uint v) { wr16(c, a, v); wr16(c, a + 2u, v >> 16u); }

static CELLFN void c0_f_run(thread Ctx& c);
static CELLFN void c0_f_run(thread Ctx& c) {
    c.r0 = 0u; c.r1 = 0u; c.r2 = 0u; c.rw = 0u; c.rn = 0u;
    TICK
    TICK
    c.slots[2u] = (ushort)(0u);
    TICK
    TICK
    c.slots[4u] = (ushort)(0u);
    TICK
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t1 = (uint)c.slots[0u];
    TICK
    uint t2 = (t1 & 31u) & 0xFFFFu;
    c.slots[3u] = (ushort)(t2);
    TICK
    for (;;) {
        TICK
        uint t3 = (uint)c.slots[4u];
        TICK
        uint t4 = (uint)c.slots[3u];
        if (!(t3 < t4)) break;
        uint t5 = 0u;
        do {
            TICK
            TICK
            c.slots[6u] = (ushort)(0u);
            TICK
            TICK
            TICK
            uint t6 = (uint)c.slots[1u];
            TICK
            uint t7 = (t6 & 31u) & 0xFFFFu;
            c.slots[5u] = (ushort)(t7);
            TICK
            for (;;) {
                TICK
                uint t8 = (uint)c.slots[6u];
                TICK
                uint t9 = (uint)c.slots[5u];
                if (!(t8 < t9)) break;
                uint t10 = 0u;
                do {
                    TICK
                    TICK
                    uint t11 = (uint)c.slots[6u];
                    TICK
                    uint t12 = (uint)c.slots[4u];
                    if (t11 == t12) {
                        TICK
                        continue;
                    }
                    TICK
                    TICK
                    uint t13 = (uint)c.slots[6u];
                    TICK
                    if (t13 > 20u) {
                        TICK
                        t10 = 1u;
                        break;
                    }
                    TICK
                    TICK
                    TICK
                    uint t14 = (uint)c.slots[2u];
                    TICK
                    uint t15 = (t14 + 1u) & 0xFFFFu;
                    c.slots[2u] = (ushort)(t15);
                } while (false);
                if (t10 != 0u) break;
                c.slots[6u] = (ushort)(((uint)c.slots[6u] + 1u) & 0xFFFFu);
            }
            TICK
            TICK
            uint t16 = (uint)c.slots[2u];
            TICK
            if (t16 > 400u) {
                TICK
                t5 = 1u;
                break;
            }
        } while (false);
        if (t5 != 0u) break;
        c.slots[4u] = (ushort)(((uint)c.slots[4u] + 1u) & 0xFFFFu);
    }
    TICK
    uint t17 = (uint)c.slots[2u];
    c.r0 = t17;
    c.rn = 1u;
}

kernel void cell_main(
    device const ushort* inp [[buffer(0)]],
    device ushort* outp [[buffer(1)]],
    device const uchar* cst [[buffer(2)]],
    constant uint& n_inputs [[buffer(3)]],
    device const uchar* stin [[buffer(4)]],
    device uchar* stout [[buffer(5)]],
    uint tid [[thread_position_in_grid]])
{
    uint cell = tid / n_inputs;
    uint idx = tid % n_inputs;
    Ctx c = {};
    c.fuel = 100000000u;
    uint r0 = 0u; uint r1 = 0u; uint r2 = 0u;
    switch (cell) {
    case 0u: {
        c.cst = cst + 0u;
        c.cst_len = 0u;
        c.slot_bytes = 14u;
        c.slots[0u] = inp[idx * 3u + 0u];
        c.slots[1u] = inp[idx * 3u + 1u];
        c0_f_run(c);
        r0 = (c.rn > 0u) ? c.r0 : 0u;
        r1 = (c.rn > 1u) ? c.r1 : 0u;
        r2 = (c.rn > 2u) ? c.r2 : 0u;
        break; }
    }
    uint steps = 100000000u - c.fuel;
    if (c.trap != 0u) {
        r0 = (c.trap == 2u) ? (c.halt & 0xFFFFu) : 0u;
        r1 = 0u;
        r2 = 0u;
    }
    outp[tid * 6u + 0u] = (ushort)r0;
    outp[tid * 6u + 1u] = (ushort)r1;
    outp[tid * 6u + 2u] = (ushort)r2;
    outp[tid * 6u + 3u] = (ushort)c.trap;
    outp[tid * 6u + 4u] = (ushort)(steps & 0xFFFFu);
    outp[tid * 6u + 5u] = (ushort)(steps >> 16u);
}

==== cell e2_loop_collatz ====
cell 0 entry=run params=1 ret_regs=1 wide_ret=false state_len=0
consts 
// generated by rustmsl — do not edit; semantics are the cell80-core interpreter's
#include <metal_stdlib>
using namespace metal;

struct Ctx {
    ushort slots[3];
    uchar state[1];
    device const uchar* cst;
    uint cst_len;
    uint slot_bytes;
    uint state_len;
    uint trap;
    uint halt;
    uint fuel;
    uint r0; uint r1; uint r2;
    uint rw;
    uint rn;
};

// The interpreter's tick(): one unit per statement, per expression
// node, per loop iteration; exhaustion is a trap, never a hang.
#define TICK if (--c.fuel == 0u) { c.trap = 4u; return; }
// Cell functions are pinned noinline: the shipped configuration is
// exactly the battery-validated one, not an inliner heuristic's.
#define CELLFN __attribute__((noinline))

// Sign-extend a masked 16-bit lane / bit-cast a 32-bit lane to signed.
static int sx16(uint x) { return (int)as_type<short>((ushort)(x)); }
static int sx32(uint x) { return as_type<int>(x); }

// Division rides opaque value-taking helpers: Metal's backend
// miscompiles a divide feeding a branch that guards stores through
// a thread-reference param (branch polarity inverts — caught by the
// E3 megakernel battery on `mul_sat`, minimised to a 10-line repro).
// The call boundary blocks the faulty fusion; zero-checks stay at
// the call site (the trap), and the signed MIN/-1 wrap lives here.
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint udiv(uint a, uint b) { return a / b; }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint urem(uint a, uint b) { return a % b; }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint sdiv16(uint a, uint b) { return ((uint)(sx16(a) / sx16(b))) & 0xFFFFu; }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint srem16(uint a, uint b) { return ((uint)(sx16(a) % sx16(b))) & 0xFFFFu; }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint sdiv32(uint a, uint b) { return (a == 0x80000000u && b == 0xFFFFFFFFu) ? a : (uint)(sx32(a) / sx32(b)); }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint srem32(uint a, uint b) { return (a == 0x80000000u && b == 0xFFFFFFFFu) ? 0u : (uint)(sx32(a) % sx32(b)); }

// Byte-routed window emulation: consts (read-only), the slot file,
// the state struct, else zero on read and a trap on write (the
// pre-registered E1 weakening).
static uint rd8(thread Ctx& c, uint a) {
    a &= 0xFFFFu;
    if (a >= 0x8000u && a < 0x8000u + c.cst_len) return (uint)c.cst[a - 0x8000u];
    if (a >= 0x9000u && a < 0x9000u + c.slot_bytes) {
        uint o = a - 0x9000u;
        return ((uint)c.slots[o >> 1] >> ((o & 1u) * 8u)) & 0xFFu;
    }
    if (a >= 0xB000u && a < 0xB000u + c.state_len) return (uint)c.state[a - 0xB000u];
    return 0u;
}
static void wr8(thread Ctx& c, uint a, uint v) {
    a &= 0xFFFFu;
    if (a >= 0x9000u && a < 0x9000u + c.slot_bytes) {
        uint o = a - 0x9000u;
        uint i = o >> 1;
        uint sh = (o & 1u) * 8u;
        c.slots[i] = (ushort)(((uint)c.slots[i] & ~(0xFFu << sh)) | ((v & 0xFFu) << sh));
        return;
    }
    if (a >= 0xB000u && a < 0xB000u + c.state_len) {
        c.state[a - 0xB000u] = (uchar)(v & 0xFFu);
        return;
    }
    c.trap = 3u;
}
static uint rd16(thread Ctx& c, uint a) { return rd8(c, a) | (rd8(c, a + 1u) << 8u); }
static void wr16(thread Ctx& c, uint a, uint v) { wr8(c, a, v); wr8(c, a + 1u, v >> 8u); }
static uint rd32(thread Ctx& c, uint a) { return rd16(c, a) | (rd16(c, a + 2u) << 16u); }
static void wr32(thread Ctx& c, uint a, uint v) { wr16(c, a, v); wr16(c, a + 2u, v >> 16u); }

static CELLFN void c0_f_run(thread Ctx& c);
static CELLFN void c0_f_run(thread Ctx& c) {
    c.r0 = 0u; c.r1 = 0u; c.r2 = 0u; c.rw = 0u; c.rn = 0u;
    TICK
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t1 = (uint)c.slots[0u];
    TICK
    uint t2 = (t1 | 1u) & 0xFFFFu;
    c.slots[1u] = (ushort)(t2);
    TICK
    TICK
    c.slots[2u] = (ushort)(0u);
    TICK
    for (;;) {
        TICK
        TICK
        TICK
        uint t3 = (uint)c.slots[1u];
        TICK
        if (t3 == 1u) {
            TICK
            break;
        }
        TICK
        TICK
        TICK
        uint t4 = (uint)c.slots[1u];
        TICK
        if (2u == 0u) { c.trap = 1u; return; }
        uint t5 = urem(t4, 2u) & 0xFFFFu;
        TICK
        if (t5 == 0u) {
            TICK
            TICK
            TICK
            uint t6 = (uint)c.slots[1u];
            TICK
            if (2u == 0u) { c.trap = 1u; return; }
            uint t7 = udiv(t6, 2u) & 0xFFFFu;
            c.slots[1u] = (ushort)(t7);
        } else {
            TICK
            TICK
            TICK
            TICK
            TICK
            uint t8 = (uint)c.slots[1u];
            TICK
            uint t9 = (t8 & 8191u) & 0xFFFFu;
            TICK
            uint t10 = (t9 * 3u) & 0xFFFFu;
            TICK
            uint t11 = (t10 + 1u) & 0xFFFFu;
            c.slots[1u] = (ushort)(t11);
        }
        TICK
        TICK
        TICK
        uint t12 = (uint)c.slots[2u];
        TICK
        uint t13 = (t12 + 1u) & 0xFFFFu;
        c.slots[2u] = (ushort)(t13);
        TICK
        TICK
        uint t14 = (uint)c.slots[2u];
        TICK
        if (t14 > 400u) {
            TICK
            break;
        }
    }
    TICK
    uint t15 = (uint)c.slots[2u];
    c.r0 = t15;
    c.rn = 1u;
}

==== cell e2_byte_loop_wrap ====

    ushort slots[3];

    device const uchar* cst;
    uint cst_len;
    uint slot_bytes;
    uint state_len;

    uint halt;
    uint fuel;

    uint rw;

        return ((uint)c.slots[o >> 1] >> ((o & 1u) * 8u)) & 0xFFu;
    }
    if (a >= 0xB000u && a < 0xB000u + c.state_len) return (uint)c.state[a - 0xB000u];
    return 0u;
}
static void wr8(thread Ctx& c, uint a, uint v) {
    a &= 0xFFFFu;
    if (a >= 0x9000u && a < 0x9000u + c.slot_bytes) {
        uint o = a - 0x9000u;
        uint i = o >> 1;
        uint sh = (o & 1u) * 8u;
        c.slots[i] = (ushort)(((uint)c.slots[i] & ~(0xFFu << sh)) | ((v & 0xFFu) << sh));
        return;
    }
    if (a >= 0xB000u && a < 0xB000u + c.state_len) {
        c.state[a - 0xB000u] = (uchar)(v & 0xFFu);
        return;
    }

static CELLFN void c0_f_run(thread Ctx& c);
static CELLFN void c0_f_run(thread Ctx& c) {
    c.r0 = 0u; c.r1 = 0u; c.r2 = 0u; c.rw = 0u; c.rn = 0u;
    TICK
    TICK
    c.slots[1u] = (ushort)(0u);
    TICK
    TICK
    c.slots[2u] = (ushort)(250u);
    TICK
    for (;;) {
        TICK
        TICK
        uint t1 = (uint)c.slots[2u];
        TICK
        if (!(t1 != 4u)) break;
        TICK
        TICK
        TICK
        uint t2 = (uint)c.slots[2u];
        TICK
        uint t3 = (t2 + 1u) & 0xFFFFu;
        c.slots[2u] = (ushort)(t3);
        TICK
        TICK
        TICK
        uint t4 = (uint)c.slots[1u];
        TICK
        uint t5 = (t4 + 1u) & 0xFFFFu;
        c.slots[1u] = (ushort)(t5);
        TICK
        TICK
        uint t6 = (uint)c.slots[1u];
        TICK
        if (t6 > 300u) {
            TICK
            break;
        }
    }
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t7 = (uint)c.slots[1u];
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t8 = (uint)c.slots[0u];
    TICK
    uint t9 = (t8 & 0u) & 0xFFFFu;
    uint t10 = (t7 + t9) & 0xFFFFu;
    c.r0 = t10;
    c.rn = 1u;
}

==== cell mem_array_sort ====

// Sign-extend a masked 16-bit lane / bit-cast a 32-bit lane to signed.
static int sx16(uint x) { return (int)as_type<short>((ushort)(x)); }
static int sx32(uint x) { return as_type<int>(x); }

// Division rides opaque value-taking helpers: Metal's backend
// miscompiles a divide feeding a branch that guards stores through
// a thread-reference param (branch polarity inverts — caught by the
// E3 megakernel battery on `mul_sat`, minimised to a 10-line repro).
// The call boundary blocks the faulty fusion; zero-checks stay at
// the call site (the trap), and the signed MIN/-1 wrap lives here.
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint udiv(uint a, uint b) { return a / b; }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint urem(uint a, uint b) { return a % b; }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint sdiv16(uint a, uint b) { return ((uint)(sx16(a) / sx16(b))) & 0xFFFFu; }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint srem16(uint a, uint b) { return ((uint)(sx16(a) % sx16(b))) & 0xFFFFu; }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint sdiv32(uint a, uint b) { return (a == 0x80000000u && b == 0xFFFFFFFFu) ? a : (uint)(sx32(a) / sx32(b)); }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint srem32(uint a, uint b) { return (a == 0x80000000u && b == 0xFFFFFFFFu) ? 0u : (uint)(sx32(a) % sx32(b)); }

// Byte-routed window emulation: consts (read-only), the slot file,
// the state struct, else zero on read and a trap on write (the
// pre-registered E1 weakening).
static uint rd8(thread Ctx& c, uint a) {
    a &= 0xFFFFu;
    if (a >= 0x8000u && a < 0x8000u + c.cst_len) return (uint)c.cst[a - 0x8000u];
    if (a >= 0x9000u && a < 0x9000u + c.slot_bytes) {
        uint o = a - 0x9000u;
        return ((uint)c.slots[o >> 1] >> ((o & 1u) * 8u)) & 0xFFu;
    }
    if (a >= 0xB000u && a < 0xB000u + c.state_len) return (uint)c.state[a - 0xB000u];
    return 0u;
}
static void wr8(thread Ctx& c, uint a, uint v) {
    a &= 0xFFFFu;
    if (a >= 0x9000u && a < 0x9000u + c.slot_bytes) {
        uint o = a - 0x9000u;
        uint i = o >> 1;
        uint sh = (o & 1u) * 8u;
        c.slots[i] = (ushort)(((uint)c.slots[i] & ~(0xFFu << sh)) | ((v & 0xFFu) << sh));
        return;
    }
    if (a >= 0xB000u && a < 0xB000u + c.state_len) {
        c.state[a - 0xB000u] = (uchar)(v & 0xFFu);
        return;
    }
    c.trap = 3u;
}
static uint rd16(thread Ctx& c, uint a) { return rd8(c, a) | (rd8(c, a + 1u) << 8u); }
static void wr16(thread Ctx& c, uint a, uint v) { wr8(c, a, v); wr8(c, a + 1u, v >> 8u); }
static uint rd32(thread Ctx& c, uint a) { return rd16(c, a) | (rd16(c, a + 2u) << 16u); }
static void wr32(thread Ctx& c, uint a, uint v) { wr16(c, a, v); wr16(c, a + 2u, v >> 16u); }

static CELLFN void c0_f_run(thread Ctx& c);
static CELLFN void c0_f_run(thread Ctx& c) {
    c.r0 = 0u; c.r1 = 0u; c.r2 = 0u; c.rw = 0u; c.rn = 0u;
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t1 = (uint)c.slots[0u];
    c.slots[1u] = (ushort)(t1);
    TICK
    TICK
    for (uint t2 = 0u; t2 < 5u; t2++) {
        wr16(c, 36868u + ((t2 * 2u) & 0xFFFFu), 0u);
    }
    TICK
    TICK
    c.slots[7u] = (ushort)(0u);
    TICK
    for (;;) {
        TICK
        TICK
        uint t3 = (uint)c.slots[1u];
        TICK
        if (!(t3 != 0u)) break;
        TICK
        TICK
        TICK
        uint t4 = (uint)c.slots[1u];
        TICK
        if (10u == 0u) { c.trap = 1u; return; }
        uint t5 = urem(t4, 10u) & 0xFFFFu;
        TICK
        uint t6 = (uint)c.slots[7u];
        uint t7 = 36868u + ((t6 * 2u) & 0xFFFFu);
        wr8(c, t7, t5);
        wr8(c, t7 + 1u, t5 >> 8u);
        TICK
        TICK
        TICK
        uint t8 = (uint)c.slots[1u];
        TICK
        if (10u == 0u) { c.trap = 1u; return; }
        uint t9 = udiv(t8, 10u) & 0xFFFFu;
        c.slots[1u] = (ushort)(t9);
        TICK
        TICK
        TICK
        uint t10 = (uint)c.slots[7u];
        TICK
        uint t11 = (t10 + 1u) & 0xFFFFu;
        c.slots[7u] = (ushort)(t11);
    }
    TICK
    TICK
    c.slots[8u] = (ushort)(0u);
    TICK
    for (;;) {
        TICK
        TICK
        uint t12 = (uint)c.slots[8u];
        TICK
        uint t13 = (uint)c.slots[7u];
        if (!(t12 < t13)) break;
        TICK
        TICK
        c.slots[9u] = (ushort)(0u);
        TICK
        for (;;) {
            TICK
            TICK
            TICK
            uint t14 = (uint)c.slots[9u];
            TICK
            uint t15 = (t14 + 1u) & 0xFFFFu;
            TICK
            TICK
            uint t16 = (uint)c.slots[7u];
            TICK
            uint t17 = (uint)c.slots[8u];
            uint t18 = (t16 - t17) & 0xFFFFu;
            if (!(t15 < t18)) break;
            TICK
            TICK
            TICK
            uint t19 = (uint)c.slots[9u];
            uint t20 = rd16(c, 36868u + ((t19 * 2u) & 0xFFFFu));
            TICK
            TICK
            TICK
            uint t21 = (uint)c.slots[9u];
            TICK
            uint t22 = (t21 + 1u) & 0xFFFFu;
            uint t23 = rd16(c, 36868u + ((t22 * 2u) & 0xFFFFu));
            if (t20 < t23) {
                TICK
                TICK
                TICK
                uint t24 = (uint)c.slots[9u];
                uint t25 = rd16(c, 36868u + ((t24 * 2u) & 0xFFFFu));
                c.slots[10u] = (ushort)(t25);
                TICK
                TICK
                TICK
                TICK
                uint t26 = (uint)c.slots[9u];
                TICK
                uint t27 = (t26 + 1u) & 0xFFFFu;
                uint t28 = rd16(c, 36868u + ((t27 * 2u) & 0xFFFFu));
                TICK
                uint t29 = (uint)c.slots[9u];
                uint t30 = 36868u + ((t29 * 2u) & 0xFFFFu);
                wr8(c, t30, t28);
                wr8(c, t30 + 1u, t28 >> 8u);
                TICK
                TICK
                uint t31 = (uint)c.slots[10u];
                TICK
                TICK
                uint t32 = (uint)c.slots[9u];
                TICK
                uint t33 = (t32 + 1u) & 0xFFFFu;
                uint t34 = 36868u + ((t33 * 2u) & 0xFFFFu);
                wr8(c, t34, t31);
                wr8(c, t34 + 1u, t31 >> 8u);
            }
            TICK
            TICK
            TICK
            uint t35 = (uint)c.slots[9u];
            TICK
            uint t36 = (t35 + 1u) & 0xFFFFu;
            c.slots[9u] = (ushort)(t36);
        }
        TICK
        TICK
        TICK
        uint t37 = (uint)c.slots[8u];
        TICK
        uint t38 = (t37 + 1u) & 0xFFFFu;
        c.slots[8u] = (ushort)(t38);
    }
    TICK
    TICK
    c.slots[11u] = (ushort)(0u & 0xFFFFu);
    c.slots[12u] = (ushort)(0u >> 16u);
    TICK
    TICK
    c.slots[13u] = (ushort)(0u);
    TICK
    for (;;) {
        TICK
        TICK
        uint t39 = (uint)c.slots[13u];
        TICK
        uint t40 = (uint)c.slots[7u];
        if (!(t39 < t40)) break;
        TICK
        TICK
        TICK
        TICK
        uint t41 = (uint)c.slots[11u] | ((uint)c.slots[12u] << 16u);
        TICK
        uint t42 = t41 * 10u;
        TICK
        TICK
        TICK
        uint t43 = (uint)c.slots[13u];
        uint t44 = rd16(c, 36868u + ((t43 * 2u) & 0xFFFFu));
        uint t45 = t42 + t44;
        c.slots[11u] = (ushort)(t45 & 0xFFFFu);
        c.slots[12u] = (ushort)(t45 >> 16u);
        TICK
        TICK
        TICK
        uint t46 = (uint)c.slots[13u];
        TICK
        uint t47 = (t46 + 1u) & 0xFFFFu;
        c.slots[13u] = (ushort)(t47);
    }
    TICK
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t48 = (uint)c.slots[11u] | ((uint)c.slots[12u] << 16u);
    TICK
    uint t49 = (t48 > 65535u) ? 1u : 0u;
    TICK
    if (t49 != 0u) {
        TICK
        TICK
        TICK
        c.trap = 2u;
        c.halt = 65285u;
        return;
        (void)0u;
    }
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t50 = (uint)c.slots[11u] | ((uint)c.slots[12u] << 16u);
    uint t51 = t50 & 0xFFFFu;
    c.r0 = t51;
    c.rn = 1u;
}

kernel void cell_main(
    device const ushort* inp [[buffer(0)]],
    device ushort* outp [[buffer(1)]],
    device const uchar* cst [[buffer(2)]],
    constant uint& n_inputs [[buffer(3)]],
    device const uchar* stin [[buffer(4)]],
    device uchar* stout [[buffer(5)]],
    uint tid [[thread_position_in_grid]])
{
    uint cell = tid / n_inputs;
    uint idx = tid % n_inputs;
    Ctx c = {};
    c.fuel = 100000000u;
    uint r0 = 0u; uint r1 = 0u; uint r2 = 0u;
    switch (cell) {
    case 0u: {
        c.cst = cst + 0u;
        c.cst_len = 0u;
        c.slot_bytes = 28u;
        c.slots[0u] = inp[idx * 3u + 0u];
        c0_f_run(c);
        r0 = (c.rn > 0u) ? c.r0 : 0u;
        r1 = (c.rn > 1u) ? c.r1 : 0u;
        r2 = (c.rn > 2u) ? c.r2 : 0u;
        break; }
    }
    uint steps = 100000000u - c.fuel;
    if (c.trap != 0u) {
        r0 = (c.trap == 2u) ? (c.halt & 0xFFFFu) : 0u;
        r1 = 0u;
        r2 = 0u;
    }
    outp[tid * 6u + 0u] = (ushort)r0;
    outp[tid * 6u + 1u] = (ushort)r1;
    outp[tid * 6u + 2u] = (ushort)r2;
    outp[tid * 6u + 3u] = (ushort)c.trap;
    outp[tid * 6u + 4u] = (ushort)(steps & 0xFFFFu);
    outp[tid * 6u + 5u] = (ushort)(steps >> 16u);
}

==== cell mem_const_table ====

#include <metal_stdlib>
using namespace metal;

struct Ctx {
    ushort slots[1];
    uchar state[1];
    device const uchar* cst;
    uint cst_len;
    uint slot_bytes;
    uint state_len;
    uint trap;
    uint halt;
    uint fuel;
    uint r0; uint r1; uint r2;
    uint rw;
    uint rn;
};

// The interpreter's tick(): one unit per statement, per expression
// node, per loop iteration; exhaustion is a trap, never a hang.
#define TICK if (--c.fuel == 0u) { c.trap = 4u; return; }
// Cell functions are pinned noinline: the shipped configuration is
// exactly the battery-validated one, not an inliner heuristic's.
#define CELLFN __attribute__((noinline))

    if (a >= 0x9000u && a < 0x9000u + c.slot_bytes) {
        uint o = a - 0x9000u;
        uint i = o >> 1;
        uint sh = (o & 1u) * 8u;
        c.slots[i] = (ushort)(((uint)c.slots[i] & ~(0xFFu << sh)) | ((v & 0xFFu) << sh));
        return;
    }
    if (a >= 0xB000u && a < 0xB000u + c.state_len) {
        c.state[a - 0xB000u] = (uchar)(v & 0xFFu);
        return;

static CELLFN void c0_f_run(thread Ctx& c);
static CELLFN void c0_f_run(thread Ctx& c) {
    c.r0 = 0u; c.r1 = 0u; c.r2 = 0u; c.rw = 0u; c.rn = 0u;
    TICK
    TICK
    TICK
    TICK
    TICK
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t1 = (uint)c.slots[0u];
    TICK
    uint t2 = (t1 & 3u) & 0xFFFFu;
    uint t3 = (t2 * 2u) & 0xFFFFu;
    uint t4 = (32768u + t3) & 0xFFFFu;
    uint t5 = rd16(c, t4);
    TICK
    TICK
    TICK
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t6 = (0u * 2u) & 0xFFFFu;
    uint t7 = (32768u + t6) & 0xFFFFu;
    uint t8 = rd16(c, t7);
    uint t9 = (t5 + t8) & 0xFFFFu;
    c.r0 = t9;
    c.rn = 1u;
}

        uint i = o >> 1;
        uint sh = (o & 1u) * 8u;
        c.slots[i] = (ushort)(((uint)c.slots[i] & ~(0xFFu << sh)) | ((v & 0xFFu) << sh));
        return;
    }
    if (a >= 0xB000u && a < 0xB000u + c.state_len) {

    TICK
    TICK

    uint t2 = t1 & 0xFFu;

    TICK

}

    case 0u: {
        c.cst = cst + 0u;
        c.cst_len = 0u;
        c.slot_bytes = 4u;
        c.slots[0u] = inp[idx * 3u + 0u];
        c.slots[1u] = inp[idx * 3u + 1u];
        c0_f_run(c);
        r0 = (c.rn > 0u) ? c.r0 : 0u;
        r1 = (c.rn > 1u) ? c.r1 : 0u;
        r2 = (c.rn > 2u) ? c.r2 : 0u;
        break; }
    }
    uint steps = 100000000u - c.fuel;
    if (c.trap != 0u) {
        r0 = (c.trap == 2u) ? (c.halt & 0xFFFFu) : 0u;
        r1 = 0u;
        r2 = 0u;
    }
    outp[tid * 6u + 0u] = (ushort)r0;
    outp[tid * 6u + 1u] = (ushort)r1;
    outp[tid * 6u + 2u] = (ushort)r2;
    outp[tid * 6u + 3u] = (ushort)c.trap;
    outp[tid * 6u + 4u] = (ushort)(steps & 0xFFFFu);
    outp[tid * 6u + 5u] = (ushort)(steps >> 16u);
}

==== state state_fields_mutate ====
cell 0 entry=S::run params=1 ret_regs=1 wide_ret=false state_len=4
consts 
// generated by rustmsl — do not edit; semantics are the cell80-core interpreter's
#include <metal_stdlib>
using namespace metal;

struct Ctx {
    ushort slots[1];
    uchar state[4];
    device const uchar* cst;
    uint cst_len;
    uint slot_bytes;
    uint state_len;
    uint trap;
    uint halt;
    uint fuel;
    uint r0; uint r1; uint r2;
    uint rw;
    uint rn;
};

// The interpreter's tick(): one unit per statement, per expression
// node, per loop iteration; exhaustion is a trap, never a hang.
#define TICK if (--c.fuel == 0u) { c.trap = 4u; return; }
// Cell functions are pinned noinline: the shipped configuration is
// exactly the battery-validated one, not an inliner heuristic's.
#define CELLFN __attribute__((noinline))

// Sign-extend a masked 16-bit lane / bit-cast a 32-bit lane to signed.
static int sx16(uint x) { return (int)as_type<short>((ushort)(x)); }
static int sx32(uint x) { return as_type<int>(x); }

// Division rides opaque value-taking helpers: Metal's backend
// miscompiles a divide feeding a branch that guards stores through
// a thread-reference param (branch polarity inverts — caught by the
// E3 megakernel battery on `mul_sat`, minimised to a 10-line repro).
// The call boundary blocks the faulty fusion; zero-checks stay at
// the call site (the trap), and the signed MIN/-1 wrap lives here.
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint udiv(uint a, uint b) { return a / b; }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint urem(uint a, uint b) { return a % b; }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint sdiv16(uint a, uint b) { return ((uint)(sx16(a) / sx16(b))) & 0xFFFFu; }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint srem16(uint a, uint b) { return ((uint)(sx16(a) % sx16(b))) & 0xFFFFu; }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint sdiv32(uint a, uint b) { return (a == 0x80000000u && b == 0xFFFFFFFFu) ? a : (uint)(sx32(a) / sx32(b)); }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint srem32(uint a, uint b) { return (a == 0x80000000u && b == 0xFFFFFFFFu) ? 0u : (uint)(sx32(a) % sx32(b)); }

// Byte-routed window emulation: consts (read-only), the slot file,
// the state struct, else zero on read and a trap on write (the
// pre-registered E1 weakening).
static uint rd8(thread Ctx& c, uint a) {
    a &= 0xFFFFu;
    if (a >= 0x8000u && a < 0x8000u + c.cst_len) return (uint)c.cst[a - 0x8000u];
    if (a >= 0x9000u && a < 0x9000u + c.slot_bytes) {
        uint o = a - 0x9000u;
        return ((uint)c.slots[o >> 1] >> ((o & 1u) * 8u)) & 0xFFu;
    }
    if (a >= 0xB000u && a < 0xB000u + c.state_len) return (uint)c.state[a - 0xB000u];
    return 0u;
}
static void wr8(thread Ctx& c, uint a, uint v) {
    a &= 0xFFFFu;
    if (a >= 0x9000u && a < 0x9000u + c.slot_bytes) {
        uint o = a - 0x9000u;
        uint i = o >> 1;
        uint sh = (o & 1u) * 8u;
        c.slots[i] = (ushort)(((uint)c.slots[i] & ~(0xFFu << sh)) | ((v & 0xFFu) << sh));
        return;
    }
    if (a >= 0xB000u && a < 0xB000u + c.state_len) {
        c.state[a - 0xB000u] = (uchar)(v & 0xFFu);
        return;
    }
    c.trap = 3u;
}
static uint rd16(thread Ctx& c, uint a) { return rd8(c, a) | (rd8(c, a + 1u) << 8u); }
static void wr16(thread Ctx& c, uint a, uint v) { wr8(c, a, v); wr8(c, a + 1u, v >> 8u); }
static uint rd32(thread Ctx& c, uint a) { return rd16(c, a) | (rd16(c, a + 2u) << 16u); }
static void wr32(thread Ctx& c, uint a, uint v) { wr16(c, a, v); wr16(c, a + 2u, v >> 16u); }

static CELLFN void c0_f_S__run(thread Ctx& c);
static CELLFN void c0_f_S__run(thread Ctx& c) {
    c.r0 = 0u; c.r1 = 0u; c.r2 = 0u; c.rw = 0u; c.rn = 0u;
    TICK
    TICK
    TICK
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t1 = (uint)c.slots[0u];
    uint t2 = rd16(c, t1 + 0u);
    TICK
    uint t3 = (t2 * 2u) & 0xFFFFu;
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t4 = (uint)c.slots[0u];
    uint t5 = rd16(c, t4 + 2u);
    uint t6 = (t3 + t5) & 0xFFFFu;
    TICK
    uint t7 = (uint)c.slots[0u];
    wr16(c, t7 + 2u, t6);
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t8 = (uint)c.slots[0u];
    uint t9 = rd16(c, t8 + 2u);
    c.r0 = t9;
    c.rn = 1u;
}

kernel void cell_main(
    device const ushort* inp [[buffer(0)]],
    device ushort* outp [[buffer(1)]],
    device const uchar* cst [[buffer(2)]],
    constant uint& n_inputs [[buffer(3)]],
    device const uchar* stin [[buffer(4)]],
    device uchar* stout [[buffer(5)]],
    uint tid [[thread_position_in_grid]])
{
    uint cell = tid / n_inputs;
    uint idx = tid % n_inputs;
    Ctx c = {};
    c.fuel = 100000000u;
    uint r0 = 0u; uint r1 = 0u; uint r2 = 0u;
    switch (cell) {
    case 0u: {
        c.cst = cst + 0u;
        c.cst_len = 0u;
        c.slot_bytes = 2u;
        c.state_len = 4u;
        for (uint si = 0u; si < 4u; si++) {
            c.state[si] = stin[0u * n_inputs + idx * 4u + si];
        }
        c.slots[0u] = 45056u;
        c0_f_S__run(c);
        r0 = (c.rn > 0u) ? c.r0 : 0u;
        r1 = (c.rn > 1u) ? c.r1 : 0u;
        r2 = (c.rn > 2u) ? c.r2 : 0u;
        for (uint so = 0u; so < 4u; so++) {
            stout[0u * n_inputs + idx * 4u + so] = c.state[so];
        }
        break; }
    }
    uint steps = 100000000u - c.fuel;
    if (c.trap != 0u) {
        r0 = (c.trap == 2u) ? (c.halt & 0xFFFFu) : 0u;
        r1 = 0u;
        r2 = 0u;
    }
    outp[tid * 6u + 0u] = (ushort)r0;
    outp[tid * 6u + 1u] = (ushort)r1;
    outp[tid * 6u + 2u] = (ushort)r2;
    outp[tid * 6u + 3u] = (ushort)c.trap;
    outp[tid * 6u + 4u] = (ushort)(steps & 0xFFFFu);
    outp[tid * 6u + 5u] = (ushort)(steps >> 16u);
}

    TICK
    c.slots[1u] = (ushort)(0u);
    TICK
    TICK
    c.slots[3u] = (ushort)(0u);
    TICK
    TICK
    c.slots[2u] = (ushort)(8u);
    TICK
    for (;;) {
        TICK
        uint t1 = (uint)c.slots[3u];
        TICK
        uint t2 = (uint)c.slots[2u];
        if (!(t1 < t2)) break;
        uint t3 = 0u;
        do {
            TICK
            TICK
            TICK
            uint t4 = (uint)c.slots[1u];
            TICK
            TICK
            uint t5 = (uint)c.slots[0u];
            TICK
            uint t6 = (uint)c.slots[3u];

            uint t8 = (t4 + t7) & 0xFFFFu;
            c.slots[1u] = (ushort)(t8);
        } while (false);
        if (t3 != 0u) break;
        c.slots[3u] = (ushort)(((uint)c.slots[3u] + 1u) & 0xFFFFu);

    TICK
    TICK
    TICK

    TICK
    uint t11 = (t10 + 1u) & 0xFFFFu;
    TICK
    uint t12 = (uint)c.slots[0u];
    wr16(c, t12 + 16u, t11);
    TICK
    uint t13 = (uint)c.slots[1u];
    c.r0 = t13;
    c.rn = 1u;
}

    uint halt;
    uint fuel;
    uint r0; uint r1; uint r2;
    uint rw;
    uint rn;
};

// The interpreter's tick(): one unit per statement, per expression
// node, per loop iteration; exhaustion is a trap, never a hang.
#define TICK if (--c.fuel == 0u) { c.trap = 4u; return; }
// Cell functions are pinned noinline: the shipped configuration is
// exactly the battery-validated one, not an inliner heuristic's.
#define CELLFN __attribute__((noinline))

// Sign-extend a masked 16-bit lane / bit-cast a 32-bit lane to signed.
static int sx16(uint x) { return (int)as_type<short>((ushort)(x)); }
static int sx32(uint x) { return as_type<int>(x); }

// Division rides opaque value-taking helpers: Metal's backend
// miscompiles a divide feeding a branch that guards stores through
// a thread-reference param (branch polarity inverts — caught by the
// E3 megakernel battery on `mul_sat`, minimised to a 10-line repro).
// The call boundary blocks the faulty fusion; zero-checks stay at
// the call site (the trap), and the signed MIN/-1 wrap lives here.
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint udiv(uint a, uint b) { return a / b; }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint urem(uint a, uint b) { return a % b; }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint sdiv16(uint a, uint b) { return ((uint)(sx16(a) / sx16(b))) & 0xFFFFu; }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint srem16(uint a, uint b) { return ((uint)(sx16(a) % sx16(b))) & 0xFFFFu; }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint sdiv32(uint a, uint b) { return (a == 0x80000000u && b == 0xFFFFFFFFu) ? a : (uint)(sx32(a) / sx32(b)); }
static __attribute__((noinline)) uint srem32(uint a, uint b) { return (a == 0x80000000u && b == 0xFFFFFFFFu) ? 0u : (uint)(sx32(a) % sx32(b)); }

// Byte-routed window emulation: consts (read-only), the slot file,
// the state struct, else zero on read and a trap on write (the
// pre-registered E1 weakening).
static uint rd8(thread Ctx& c, uint a) {
    a &= 0xFFFFu;
    if (a >= 0x8000u && a < 0x8000u + c.cst_len) return (uint)c.cst[a - 0x8000u];
    if (a >= 0x9000u && a < 0x9000u + c.slot_bytes) {
        uint o = a - 0x9000u;
        return ((uint)c.slots[o >> 1] >> ((o & 1u) * 8u)) & 0xFFu;
    }
    if (a >= 0xB000u && a < 0xB000u + c.state_len) return (uint)c.state[a - 0xB000u];
    return 0u;
}
static void wr8(thread Ctx& c, uint a, uint v) {
    a &= 0xFFFFu;
    if (a >= 0x9000u && a < 0x9000u + c.slot_bytes) {
        uint o = a - 0x9000u;
        uint i = o >> 1;
        uint sh = (o & 1u) * 8u;
        c.slots[i] = (ushort)(((uint)c.slots[i] & ~(0xFFu << sh)) | ((v & 0xFFu) << sh));
        return;
    }
    if (a >= 0xB000u && a < 0xB000u + c.state_len) {
        c.state[a - 0xB000u] = (uchar)(v & 0xFFu);
        return;
    }
    c.trap = 3u;
}
static uint rd16(thread Ctx& c, uint a) { return rd8(c, a) | (rd8(c, a + 1u) << 8u); }
static void wr16(thread Ctx& c, uint a, uint v) { wr8(c, a, v); wr8(c, a + 1u, v >> 8u); }
static uint rd32(thread Ctx& c, uint a) { return rd16(c, a) | (rd16(c, a + 2u) << 16u); }
static void wr32(thread Ctx& c, uint a, uint v) { wr16(c, a, v); wr16(c, a + 2u, v >> 16u); }

static CELLFN void c0_f_run(thread Ctx& c);
static CELLFN void c0_f_run(thread Ctx& c) {
    c.r0 = 0u; c.r1 = 0u; c.r2 = 0u; c.rw = 0u; c.rn = 0u;
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t1 = (uint)c.slots[0u];
    c.slots[2u] = (ushort)(t1);
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t2 = (uint)c.slots[1u];
    c.slots[3u] = (ushort)(t2);
    TICK
    for (;;) {
        TICK
        TICK
        uint t3 = (uint)c.slots[3u];
        TICK
        if (!(t3 != 0u)) break;
        TICK
        TICK
        TICK
        uint t4 = (uint)c.slots[2u];
        TICK
        uint t5 = (uint)c.slots[3u];
        if (t5 == 0u) { c.trap = 1u; return; }
        uint t6 = urem(t4, t5) & 0xFFFFu;
        c.slots[4u] = (ushort)(t6);
        TICK
        TICK
        uint t7 = (uint)c.slots[3u];
        c.slots[2u] = (ushort)(t7);
        TICK
        TICK
        uint t8 = (uint)c.slots[4u];
        c.slots[3u] = (ushort)(t8);
    }
    TICK
    uint t9 = (uint)c.slots[2u];
    c.r0 = t9;
    c.rn = 1u;
}

static CELLFN void c1_f_S__run(thread Ctx& c);
static CELLFN void c1_f_S__run(thread Ctx& c) {
    c.r0 = 0u; c.r1 = 0u; c.r2 = 0u; c.rw = 0u; c.rn = 0u;
    TICK
    TICK
    TICK
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t10 = (uint)c.slots[0u];
    uint t11 = rd16(c, t10 + 0u);
    TICK
    uint t12 = (t11 * 2u) & 0xFFFFu;
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t13 = (uint)c.slots[0u];
    uint t14 = rd16(c, t13 + 2u);
    uint t15 = (t12 + t14) & 0xFFFFu;
    TICK
    uint t16 = (uint)c.slots[0u];
    wr16(c, t16 + 2u, t15);
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t17 = (uint)c.slots[0u];
    uint t18 = rd16(c, t17 + 2u);
    c.r0 = t18;
    c.rn = 1u;
}

static CELLFN void c2_f_run(thread Ctx& c);
static CELLFN void c2_f_run(thread Ctx& c) {
    c.r0 = 0u; c.r1 = 0u; c.r2 = 0u; c.rw = 0u; c.rn = 0u;
    TICK
    TICK
    TICK
    TICK
    TICK
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t19 = (uint)c.slots[0u];
    TICK
    uint t20 = (t19 & 3u) & 0xFFFFu;
    uint t21 = (t20 * 2u) & 0xFFFFu;
    uint t22 = (32768u + t21) & 0xFFFFu;
    uint t23 = rd16(c, t22);
    TICK
    TICK
    TICK
    TICK
    TICK
    uint t24 = (0u * 2u) & 0xFFFFu;
    uint t25 = (32768u + t24) & 0xFFFFu;
    uint t26 = rd16(c, t25);
    uint t27 = (t23 + t26) & 0xFFFFu;
    c.r0 = t27;
    c.rn = 1u;
}

kernel void cell_main(
    device const ushort* inp [[buffer(0)]],
    device ushort* outp [[buffer(1)]],
    device const uchar* cst [[buffer(2)]],
    constant uint& n_inputs [[buffer(3)]],
    device const uchar* stin [[buffer(4)]],
    device uchar* stout [[buffer(5)]],
    uint tid [[thread_position_in_grid]])
{
    uint cell = tid / n_inputs;
    uint idx = tid % n_inputs;
    Ctx c = {};
    c.fuel = 100000000u;
    uint r0 = 0u; uint r1 = 0u; uint r2 = 0u;
    switch (cell) {
    case 0u: {
        c.cst = cst + 0u;
        c.cst_len = 0u;
        c.slot_bytes = 10u;
        c.slots[0u] = inp[idx * 3u + 0u];
        c.slots[1u] = inp[idx * 3u + 1u];
        c0_f_run(c);
        r0 = (c.rn > 0u) ? c.r0 : 0u;
        r1 = (c.rn > 1u) ? c.r1 : 0u;
        r2 = (c.rn > 2u) ? c.r2 : 0u;
        break; }
    case 1u: {
        c.cst = cst + 0u;
        c.cst_len = 0u;
        c.slot_bytes = 2u;
        c.state_len = 4u;
        for (uint si = 0u; si < 4u; si++) {
            c.state[si] = stin[0u * n_inputs + idx * 4u + si];
        }
        c.slots[0u] = 45056u;
        c1_f_S__run(c);
        r0 = (c.rn > 0u) ? c.r0 : 0u;
        r1 = (c.rn > 1u) ? c.r1 : 0u;
        r2 = (c.rn > 2u) ? c.r2 : 0u;
        for (uint so = 0u; so < 4u; so++) {
            stout[0u * n_inputs + idx * 4u + so] = c.state[so];
        }
        break; }
    case 2u: {
        c.cst = cst + 0u;
        c.cst_len = 8u;
        c.slot_bytes = 2u;
        c.slots[0u] = inp[idx * 3u + 0u];
        c2_f_run(c);
        r0 = (c.rn > 0u) ? c.r0 : 0u;
        r1 = (c.rn > 1u) ? c.r1 : 0u;
        r2 = (c.rn > 2u) ? c.r2 : 0u;
        break; }
    }
    uint steps = 100000000u - c.fuel;
    if (c.trap != 0u) {
        r0 = (c.trap == 2u) ? (c.halt & 0xFFFFu) : 0u;
        r1 = 0u;
        r2 = 0u;
    }
    outp[tid * 6u + 0u] = (ushort)r0;
    outp[tid * 6u + 1u] = (ushort)r1;
    outp[tid * 6u + 2u] = (ushort)r2;
    outp[tid * 6u + 3u] = (ushort)c.trap;
    outp[tid * 6u + 4u] = (ushort)(steps & 0xFFFFu);
    outp[tid * 6u + 5u] = (ushort)(steps >> 16u);
}
